runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W6W) Ridden along from a wide draw, gradually shifted backward to midfield onto first bend remaining wide without cover, yielded ground noticeably from over 500M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W6W) 自外檔出閘後受催策。開始轉首個彎位時逐漸墮居中間位置，走外疊，沒有遮擋。自五百米處起顯著墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Jumped well, raced 2 wide better than midfield early, steadied near 1050M, 2 wide in midfield on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，早段居中間之前位置，走第二疊。接近一千零五十米處時收慢。直路彎居中間位置，走第二疊。直路早段未能再增速，其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Slightly slow out and made contact, raced at rear throughout, never a factor.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘稍慢，被觸碰。沿途居後列。從未有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W3W) Crowded leaving stalls, raced in last pair, hung left bend and struggling into home straight, soon well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W3W) 出閘時受擠迫，居最後兩位。直路彎外閃，入直路時掙扎上前，瞬即遙遙落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Held up last after bumped heavily out of stalls and lost balance, ridden along 400m out but detached, never involved.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;躍出時與對手互相大力碰撞，失去平衡，其後留後。四百米處受催策，但被拋離。從未參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W1W) Slowly into stride, driven to recover and take up prominent position, led halfway, two lengths clear 300m out, ran on well for pressure, always doing enough.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W1W) 出閘緩慢。受催策以恢復走勢，居前列。半程時領先。三百米處領先兩個馬位。在催策下走勢良佳，一直保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W3W2W) Bumped shortly after start, raced in midfield on the outside, moved closer after passing 700M, 1/2L back turning in, took the lead 200M, kept on well to hold off the challengers late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W3W2W) 起步後不久與一駒互相碰撞，居中間位置，走外疊。跑過七百米處後追近，入直路時落後半個馬位。二百米處取得領先，保持佳勢，末段力拒對手的挑戰取勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Tracked leaders, keen middle stages and switched wide, under pressure 500m out, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。中段搶口及移出外疊。五百米處受催策。末段在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat on pace, traveled okay, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領放馬，走勢尚可。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W1W1W) Made contact at start, positioned 3-1/2L behind the leader on rail, saved ground throughout, kept on well in straight to take 2nd, no threat to the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W1W1W) 起步時發生觸碰，落後領放馬三個半馬位，走內欄。沿途走內欄節省腳程。直路上保持佳勢，跑獲亞軍，未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W2W) Made contact at start, raced better than midfield on the outside, 3-1/2L back turning in, finished off well to make frame.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W2W) 起步時發生觸碰，居中間之前位置，走外疊。入直路時落後三個半馬位。衝刺良佳，取得第四名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W5W) Jumped awkwardly and unbalanced, raced slightly behind midfield on the outside, 3-1/2L back, same margin back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W5W) 出閘笨拙及失去平衡，居中間稍後位置，落後三個半馬位，走外疊。入直路時落後相同距離。直路初未能再增速。其後逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W1W1W) Taken back to race at rear on the inside, saved ground to turn, passed some tired runners in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 留居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上超越數匹已呈疲態的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Tracked pace, weakened 200m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領放馬。二百米處轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W2W) Began only fairly and made contact, raced at rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, showed some response early in straight, not enough room near 200M, made good progress thereafter to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，與他駒互相觸碰，居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初對催策略有反應。接近二百米處時空位不足。其後追前甚多，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W3W3W) Jumped with them, raced towards rear on the inside early, angled out after entering the back straight, 7 to 8 lengths back turning in, made no impression in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W3W3W) 與對手同步躍出，早段居後列，走內疊。進入對面直路後向外移出。入直路時落後七至八個馬位。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W3W4W) Average to begin, raced 2 wide in midfield early, 3 wide after entering the back straight, moved closer after passing 900M, 2 lengths or so back turning in, kept on well in straight to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W3W4W) 出閘普通，早段居中間位置，走第二疊。進入對面直路後走第三疊。跑過九百米處後追近。入直路時落後約兩個馬位，直路上保持佳勢，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W5W) Jumped only fairly, raced 3 wide behind midfield, hard ridden after passing 550M, very wide turning in, made no impression in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W5W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走第三疊。跑過五百五十米處後受力策。入直路時走大外疊。直路上毫無表現。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (1W1W1W1W) Made contact shortly after start, raced behind midfield on the inside, moved a bit closer along the rail on turn, finished off well to make frame.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(1W1W1W1W) 起步後不久發生觸碰，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎沿欄略為追近。衝刺良佳，取得第四名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Waited with in rear from wide draw, short of room top of home straight, stayed on once clear 300m out, never a threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 自外檔出閘，居後列，留力候上。直路初空位不足。三百米處望空後隨即保持走勢。從未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Taken back from gate 12, raced towards rear on the outside, 5 lengths back turning in, one-paced in the run home. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 自第十二檔出閘，留居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後五個馬位。末段保持同速。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W) Taken back to race 2 wide behind midfield, angled out 350M, made good progress in straight to be nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W) 留居中間之後位置，走第二疊。三百五十米處向外移出。直路上追前甚多，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Out with rest, raced slightly behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, no clear run until approaching 150M, finished off well to make frame without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間稍後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。未能望空直至趨近一百五十米處。末段衝刺良佳，取得第四名，但未能威脅頭三名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W) Crowded shortly after start, raced slightly behind midfield on the inside, a bit closer on turn, 2 wide after passing 500M, no clear run early in straight, kept on evenly thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W) 起步後不久受擠迫，居中間稍後位置，走內疊。直路彎略為追近。跑過五百米處後走第二疊。直路早段未能望空，其後保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W3W) Jumped awkwardly, settled towards rear, lay in inside 200M, closed off okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W3W) 出閘笨拙，居後列。最後二百米內閃。末段衝刺不俗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W3W) Rail position in mid-field, angled off rail on bend, good headway early part of home straight, no extra final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W3W) 居中間位置，走內欄。直路彎移離內欄。直路早段以佳勢上前。最後一百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W6W) Out in line, raced 3 wide towards rear, carried wider from 550M, very wide into straight, made no progress in the run home. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W6W) 與對手同步出閘，居後列，走第三疊。自五百五十米處起被帶出更外疊。入直路時走大外疊。直路上毫無進展。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Made contact shortly after start, raced at rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, made minor progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 起步後不久與對手互相觸碰，居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Bumped leaving stalls, waited with in rear, short of room early in home straight, unable to quicken.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 出閘時與對手互相碰撞，居後列，留力候上。直路早段空位不足。末段未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W3W) Jumped only fairly, settled in front of midfield, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W3W) 出閘僅屬一般。居中間之前位置。末段走勢平穩。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Ridden along from stalls to press leader, challenged leader 500m out, ran on well to lead narrowly 200m out, crossed by winner 50m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 出閘後受催策，追迫領放馬。五百米處挑戰領放馬。以佳勢上前，二百米處以短距離領先。五十米處被頭馬超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, followed winner through 400m out, ran on well final 200m but no match for winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。四百米處跟隨頭馬上前。最後二百米走勢良佳，但未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (4W6W) Taken back from gate 13, raced towards rear on the outside, there to turn, made good progress in straight to make frame, nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(4W6W) 自第十三檔出閘後留居後列，走外疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路上追前甚多，取得第四名，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Jumped with them, showed no early speed, raced at tail, 8 lengths back turning in, made some headway in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 與對手同步躍出，缺乏前速，居包尾位置。入直路時落後八個馬位。直路上略為追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Jumped with them, raced 2 wide slightly behind midfield, 5 lengths back turning in, no clear run early in straight, kept on same pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間稍後位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後五個馬位。直路早段未能望空。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Bumped shortly after start, raced towards rear on the inside, 7 lengths back turning in, made no impression in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 起步後不久被碰撞，居後列，走內疊。入直路時落後七個馬位。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Sat behind midfield 3 wide, made no impression. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。毫無表現。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Settled in mid-field, taken wider 500m out, ridden top of home straight, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 居中間位置。五百米處被帶出較外疊。直路初受催策，未能增速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W2W) Taken back from gate 12, raced at rear on the inside, 6-1/2L back turning in, made minor progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W2W) 自第十二檔出閘，留居後列，走內疊。入直路時落後六個半馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, ridden along to hold position 700m out, good headway up rail final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。七百米處受催策以保持位置。最後二百米沿欄追前甚多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Crowded briefly at start, in rear, stayed on final 300m, never going pace to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 起步時一度受擠迫，居後列。最後三百米保持走勢。從未能加速追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W) Crowded start, raced at rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, showed some response early in straight, no clear run from 250M to 100M, made good progress thereafter to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W) 起步時受擠迫，居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初對催策略有反應。二百五十米處至一百米處之間未能望空。其後追前甚多，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Rail position in rear of mid-field, ridden top of home straight, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。直路初受催策，但未能增速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Rail position in rear of mid-field, had to wait for run early in home straight, clear run final 200m, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。直路早段須等待空位出現。最後二百米望空，保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped only fairly, settled in front of midfield, made good ground inside 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之前位置。二百米處追前甚多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W) Dropped out from widest draw, pushed along widest into home straight, never going pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W) 自大外檔出閘後墮後。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。從未能加速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (1W1W1W2W) Slightly slow out from gate 1, raced in midfield on the inside, 3 lengths back in the middle stages, angled out early in straight, finished off well to take 2nd, nearest on line. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(1W1W1W2W) 自第一檔出閘稍慢，居中間位置，走內疊。中段落後三個馬位。直路早段向外移出。末段衝刺良佳，跑獲亞軍，過終點時最為接近。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Away with them, raced 2 wide in midfield, 3 lengths or so back turning in, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後約三個馬位。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W3W) Moderately away from the widest draw, raced 2 wide better than midfield, 4 lengths back turning in, kept on same pace in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 自大外檔出閘普通，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後四個馬位，直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W1W) Began well from gate 1, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, made some progress early in straight, peaked 150M, weakened gradually close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初略為追前。一百五十米處未能再增速。接近終點時逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W2W2W2W) Average to begin, sent forward to race prominently, 2 wide, hard ridden from 600M but only showed limited response, weakened early in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W2W2W2W) 出閘普通，受催策上前，居前列，走第二疊。自六百米處起受力策，但反應僅屬一般。直路早段轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Made running, under pressure 550m to maintain position, headed early in home straight, gave ground final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 領放。五百五十米處受催策以保持位置。直路初被超越。最後二百米墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Bumped start, raced towards rear on the inside, 6 lengths or so back turning in, made some progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 起步時發生碰撞，居後列，走內疊。入直路時落後約六個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (6W4W2W2W) Bumped shortly after start, raced at rear throughout, never a factor.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(6W4W2W2W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，沿途居後列。從未有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W4W) Away well, raced 2 wide better than midfield, 3 wide on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W4W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。直路彎走第三疊。直路早段未能再增速，其後逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W4W) Began only fairly and crowded, raced 2 wide behind midfield, moved closer on turn, 4 wide turning in, showed limited response early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W4W) 出閘僅屬一般及受擠迫，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。直路彎追近。入直路時走第四疊。直路初在催策下反應平平。其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W1W) Crowded shortly after start, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, showed limited response early in straight, weakened final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 起步後不久受擠迫，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段對催策反應平平。最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W3W) Moderately away from a wide draw, raced 3 wide with cover in midfield, similar position on turn, failed to close off in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W3W) 自外檔出閘普通，居中間位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。直路彎居相若位置。直路上衝刺乏力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Crowded at start, never better than midfield, one paced under pressure in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 起步時受擠迫，從未超越中間位置。直路上在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W3W) Sat off midfield 2 wide, never a threat. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。從未能構成威脅。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (5W3W3W4W) Moderately away from a wide draw, raced 3 wide with cover in midfield, angled out 500M, 3 lengths back turning in, peaked early in straight, kept on same pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(5W3W3W4W) 自外檔出閘普通，居中間位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。五百米處向外移出。入直路時落後三個馬位。直路早段未能再增速，保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Towards rear, brief forward move early in home straight, soon weakened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居後列。直路初一度發力上前。瞬即轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W2W3W) Jumped well, raced 2 wide better than midfield, hard ridden from 450M, kept on well in straight to take a place, not quite able to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W2W3W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。自四百五十米處起受力策。直路上保持佳勢，跑獲季軍，但未能構成真正威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W5W5W) Three wide in mid-field, under pressure 550m out, stayed on steadily to close on leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W5W5W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。五百五十米處受催策。保持穩勢，追近領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W1W1W1W) Jumped with them, sent forward to take the lead, travelled comfortably to turn, kept on very well in straight, won comfortably.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W1W1W1W) 與對手同步出閘，受催策上前領放。直路彎前走勢暢順。直路上保持甚佳走勢，從容獲勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W2W) Rail position in mid-field, under pressure to hold position final bend, crowded and checked 200m out, lost all chance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W2W) 居中間位置，走內欄。直路彎在催策下保持位置。二百米處受擠迫及勒避，再無爭勝機會。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W3W) Tracked pace, stuck to task under pressure but lacked pace to challenge winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W3W) 跟隨領放馬。受催策力拼，但速度不足以挑戰頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W2W3W) Taken back to race 2 wide behind midfield, angled out approaching 350M, made no progress in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W2W3W) 留居中間之後位置，走第二疊。趨近三百五十米處時向外移出。直路上毫無進展。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W4W) Jumped well from a wide draw, raced slightly better than midfield on outer, no cover throughout, 3 lengths or so back turning in, kept on same pace in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W4W) 自外檔出閘迅速，居中間稍前位置，走外疊。沿途沒有遮擋。入直路時落後約三個馬位。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Sat in front of midfield, weakened passing 250M, gave ground quickly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 居中間之前位置。跑過二百五十米處時轉弱，迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W4W) Settled in front of midfield, raced wide, hung out in the Home Straight, failed to run out (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W4W) 居中間之前位置，走外疊。直路上外閃，未能追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W) Made contact at start, raced 2 wide better than midfield, bumped near 600M, 2-1/2L back turning in, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W) 起步時發生觸碰，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。接近六百米處時發生碰撞。入直路時落後兩個半馬位。以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Shifted out at start and made contact, raced 2 wide towards rear, angled out and made contact near 450M, no clear run until approaching final 100M, made no progress thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 起步時向外斜跑及與對手互相觸碰，居後列，走第二疊。接近四百五十米處時向外移出及發生觸碰。未能望空直至趨近一百米處。其後毫無進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Sat on pace, weakened slightly passing the 250M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居前列。跑過二百五十米處時略為轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W) Tracked leading pair, ridden to challenge 300m out, tended to edge right, no extra final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領放兩駒。三百米處在催策下展開挑戰，傾向內閃。最後二百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Settled towards the rear 2 wide, made no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居後列，走第二疊。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Dropped out from wide draw, still in rear top of home straight, unable to secure clear run until 300m out, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 自外檔出閘後墮後。直路初仍居後列。未能望空直至三百米處。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Sat on pace on the rail, gave ground final 200M. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領放馬，走內欄。最後二百米墮退。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Bumped shortly after start, raced in midfield, 2 wide, 4 lengths or so back turning in, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 起步後不久被碰撞，居中間位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後約四個馬位。衝刺平穩。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W3W4W) Shifted out at start and made heavy contact, raced 3 wide with cover behind midfield, very wide turning in, showed limited response early in straight, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W3W4W) 起步時向外斜跑，與對手互相大力觸碰，居中間之後位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。入直路時走大外疊。直路初對催策反應平平。保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Crowded shortly after start, raced behind midfield on the inside, 5 lengths or so back turning in, made some progress early in straight, peaked on run 200M, weakened gradually final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 起步後不久受擠迫，居中間之後位置，走內疊。入直路時落後約五個馬位。直路早段略為追前。二百米處未能再增速，最後一百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Sat off pace 2 wide, unable to quickened. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居領放馬之後，走第二疊。末段未能加速。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Settled behind midfield 2 wide, stayed on okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。保持不俗走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Mid-field, stayed on final 200m, unable to reach winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置。最後二百米保持走勢，未能追上頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Settled well behind on rail and waited with, snuck closer on the inside after straightening but ran out of room from 300M out and forced to check and stumbled over 100M out, never recovered.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 遙居於後，留力候上，走內欄。入直路後在內疊追近，但自三百米處起空位不足。一百米處被迫勒避，失蹄，從未恢復走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Bumped shortly after start, taken back to race at rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, made minor progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，留居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W1W) Hampered soon after start, held up in last pair, headway up inside rail final 150m, never a threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W1W) 起步後瞬即受阻礙，留居最後兩位之內。最後一百五十米沿內欄追前。從未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W3W) Settled handy, finished off nicely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W3W) 居前列。末段衝刺良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, well placed into home straight, stayed on well but unable to reach winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。入直路時居好位。末段保持佳勢，但未能追上頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Ridden along to lead, traveled fairly, weakened passing 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 在催策下領放。走勢一般。跑過二百米處時轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Pushed along from stalls to lead, challenged by rivals 500m out, headed by runner-up 200m out, fought back to lead again 50m out, just prevailed.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘後受推策以取得領先。五百米處受對手挑戰。二百米處被亞軍馬匹超越。五十米處反先該駒再次取得領先，險勝而回。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Commenced well, raced better than midfield on the outside, 2 lengths or so back, same margin back on turn, showed limited response early in straight, weakened gradually final 100M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，落後約兩個馬位，走外疊。直路彎落後相同距離。直路初對催策反應平平。最後一百米逐漸轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Tracked leader, pushed along to chase leader 600m out, stayed on well and just held on in tight finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 跟隨領放馬。六百米處受推策以追趕領放馬。保持佳勢，在多駒幾乎齊過終點下僅勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W) Jumped awkwardly, raced 3 wide slightly behind midfield, similar position on turn, no clear run early in straight, cleared after passing 200M, finished off well to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W) 出閘笨拙，居中間稍後位置，走第三疊。直路彎居相若位置。直路初未能望空。跑過二百米處後望空。末段衝刺良佳，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: From draw 14, sent forward to take the lead, there to turn, weakened final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 自第十四檔出閘，受催策上前領放，直路彎前居相同位置，最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Tracked leader, keen early, ridden along top of home straight, flattened out final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領放馬，早段搶口。直路初受催策。最後二百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W4W) Began well from a wide draw, unable to slot in, raced 4 wide better than midfield, no cover throughout, peaked early in straight, weakened final furlong. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W4W) 自外檔出閘迅速，未能切入內欄，居中間之前位置，走第四疊。沿途沒有遮擋。直路初未能再增速。最後二百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Sat last, never involved.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居包尾位置。從未參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W4W) Raced in touch, three wide, made effort 300m out, no extra final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W4W) 緊隨領先馬匹，走第三疊。三百米處發力。最後一百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Jumped well and led, kept on until weakened final 75M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速及領放。保持走勢直至最後七十五米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Tracked pace, ridden to chase leading pair 400m out, unable to stay with that pair, no extra final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領放馬。四百米處在催策下追趕領先兩駒，但未能跟上。最後一百五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W3W3W2W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced at tail, still 7 to 8 lengths back turning in, made some headway in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W3W3W2W) 自大外檔出閘後留居包尾位置。入直路時仍落後七至八個馬位。直路上略為追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W) Moderately away, raced slightly behind midfield on the outside, 4 lengths or so back, similar position on turn, made no progress in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W) 出閘普通。居中間稍後位置，落後約四個馬位，走外疊。直路彎居相若位置。直路上毫無進展。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W2W) Bumped shortly after start and unbalanced, raced better than midfield but trapped wide early, 2 wide after entering the back straight, 2 lengths back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W2W) 起步後不久被碰撞，失去平衡。居中間之前位置，但早段走外疊。進入對面直路後走第二疊。入直路時落後兩個馬位。直路早段未能再增速，其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Shifted across to the tail of the field from gate 13, swung wide for a run at the home straight, rushed home despite laying in.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 自第十三檔出閘，切入居尾列。直路上向外移出取位。儘管內閃，但末段衝刺良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (5W3W3W) Held up in last pair from wide draw, still in rear entering home straight, hung right, little impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(5W3W3W) 自大外檔出閘後留居最後兩位之內。入直路時仍居後列。內閃，無甚表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W2W) Sat midfield 3 wide, limited response when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W2W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。對催策反應平平。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W4W4W) In last few after beginning from the widest barrier, jockey reported lost use of iron briefly, improved steadily in back straight to reach midfield 4-wide onto home bend, even wider turning in for home, soon weakened on straightening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W4W4W) 自大外檔出閘後居最後數位之內。騎師報告，他的左腳曾脫出腳踏。對面直路上穩步上前，開始轉直路彎時進佔中間位置，走第四疊。入直路時走更外疊，瞬即轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (5W4W4W6W) Bumped shortly after start, raced at rear on the outside, very wide turning in, made no progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(5W4W4W6W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，居後列，走外疊。入直路時走大外疊。直路上毫無進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W3W2W) Bumped start and unbalanced, raced 2 wide towards rear, 6 lengths back turning in, passed some tired runners in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W3W2W) 起步時發生碰撞，失去平衡。居後列，走第二疊。入直路時落後六個馬位。直路上超越數匹已呈疲態的對手。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W3W4W) Jumped only fairly, taken back to race towards rear on the outside, 5 to 6 lengths back turning in, passed some tired runners in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W3W4W) 出閘僅屬一般，留居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後五至六個馬位，直路上超越數匹已呈疲態的對手。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W2W3W) Crowded shortly after start, raced 2 wide better than midfield, 3-1/4L back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W2W3W) 起步後不久受擠迫，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後三又四分一個馬位。直路早段未能再增速，其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W3W) Settled in mid-field, switched for clear run 300m out, tended to hang in final 200m, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W3W) 居中間位置。三百米處轉換跑線以望空。最後二百米傾向內閃。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W2W2W3W) Jumped well from gate 10, raced 2 wide better than midfield, 3 wide turning in, showed some response early in straight, peaked on run 200M, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W2W2W3W) 自第十檔出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。入直路時走第三疊。直路早段對催策略有反應。二百米處未能再增速，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W3W3W3W) Tracked leaders, headway final bend to chase leaders, quickened early in home straight and soon in command, margin reduced closing stages but always doing enough.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W3W3W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。直路彎上前追趕領先馬匹。直路初加速，瞬即控制大局。末段領先距離收窄，但一直保持佳勢，穩操勝券。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W2W4W) Away with them, raced 2 wide towards rear, 5 lengths or so back, wider turning in, failed to close off in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W2W4W) 與對手同步出閘，居後列，落後約五個馬位，走第二疊。入直路時走較外疊。直路上衝刺乏力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast; (2W2W3W6W) Taken back from gate 9, raced at tail throughout, never a factor. (See Racing Incidents.)
(Roarer again.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速;(2W2W3W6W) 自第九檔出閘後留後，沿途居包尾位置。從未有力一爭。（見競賽事件報告。）
（再次患有喘鳴症。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W3W4W) Held up, under pressure long way out, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W3W4W) 留後。距離終點尚遠時已受催策。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Jumped only fairly, sat behind midfield, minor progress made.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W1W) Began only fairly, raced behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, made some progress early in straight, kept on evenly inside final furlong. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段略為追前。最後二百米保持穩勢。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (4W3W3W3W4W5W) Jumped awkwardly, settled behind midfield, raced wide and without cover throughout, very limited when asked.
(Roarer again.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(4W3W3W3W4W5W) 出閘笨拙，居中間之後位置。沿途走外疊，沒有遮擋。對催策反應頗為有限。
（再次患有喘鳴症。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W5W) Held up from wide draw, last and pushed along turning into home straight, stayed on, unable to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W5W) 自外檔出閘後留後。轉入直路時居包尾位置，受推策。保持走勢，未能追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W3W3W4W) Moderately away, raced towards rear on the outside, very wide turning in, failed to make any progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W3W3W4W) 出閘普通，居後列，走外疊。入直路時走大外疊。直路上毫無進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W2W3W) Moderately away from gate 1, raced slightly behind midfield on the inside, 2 wide after entering the back straight, wider turning in, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W2W3W) 自第一檔出閘普通，居中間稍後位置，走內疊。進入對面直路後走第二疊。入直路時走較外疊。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W3W3W3W3W3W) Bumped shortly after start, raced very wide throughout, improved to track pace out wide without cover 1500m out, effort 500m out, no extra final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W3W3W3W3W3W) 起步後不久被碰撞，沿途走大外疊。千五米處上前跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。五百米處受催策。最後一百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W2W4W) Began only fairly from a wide draw, raced behind midfield on the outside, 6 lengths back turning in, made some progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W2W4W) 自外檔出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走外疊。入直路時落後六個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W1W2W) Commenced well, raced in midfield on the inside, 2 wide turning in, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W1W2W) 出閘迅速，居中間位置，走內疊。入直路時走第二疊。末段衝刺平穩。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Began only fairly, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened gradually thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初未能再增速。其後逐漸轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W2W) Sat worse than midfield on the rail, picked off a few weakened rivals. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W2W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。末段超越數匹已轉弱的對手。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W2W2W) Began well, raced in 2nd, 2 wide, there to turn, kept on well early in straight, peaked 150M, weakened final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 出閘迅速，居第二位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路早段保持佳勢。一百五十米處未能再增速。最後五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(+) (2W2W2W2W) Began well, raced 2 wide in 2nd, 1/2L back, same position on turn, kept on well early in straight, peaked on run 150M, kept on evenly to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(+)(2W2W2W2W) 出閘迅速，居第二位，落後半個馬位，走第二疊。直路彎居相同位置。直路早段保持佳勢。一百五十米處未能再增速。末段保持穩勢，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W2W2W) Average to begin, raced 2 wide in midfield, found rail near 400M, kept to inside after straightening and finished off well to take 2nd. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W2W2W) 出閘普通，居中間位置，走第二疊。接近四百米處時移入內欄。入直路後固守內欄，末段衝刺良佳，跑獲亞軍。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Settled in front of midfield, traveled smoothly, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 居中間之前位置，走勢暢順。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Shifted out at start and bumped, raced better than midfield on the outside, finished off strongly, just beaten in a ding-dong battle.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 起步時向外斜跑，被碰撞。居中間之前位置，走外疊。末段衝刺強勁，叮噹馬頭下僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W2W2W) Shifted out and bumped at start, mid division, challenged and every chance from 300m out, ran on well but no match for winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W2W2W) 起步時向外斜跑及發生碰撞。居中間位置。自三百米處起展開挑戰，一度甚具爭勝機會。走勢良佳，但不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast; (2W2W) Began smartly from the widest draw, raced prominently on the outside, there to turn, peaked early in straight, weakened final 300M. (See Racing Incidents.)
(Irregular heart rhythm.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速;(2W2W) 自大外檔出閘迅速，居前列，走外疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路早段未能再增速。最後三百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）
（心律不正常。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W3W3W5W) Taken back to race 3 wide with cover towards rear, 6 lengths or so back turning in, made some progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W3W3W5W) 留居後列，走第三疊，有遮擋。入直路時落後約六個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Rear of mid-field, limited response to pressure home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居中間之後位置。直路上對催策反應平平。 毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Crowded at start, settled in mid-field, pushed along 500m out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 起步時受擠迫，居中間位置。五百米處受推策。速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Made running, pressed in front, headed by winner top of home straight, dropped away quickly, eased once well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 帶頭競跑，在領放下受追迫。直路初被頭馬超越。迅速墮退，落後甚遠時隨即收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Jumped only fairly, settled in front of midfield, switched out entering the Straight, closed off okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之前位置。入直路時向外移出。末段衝刺不俗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Jumped awkwardly, raced at tail, still last turning in, taken wide in straight and finished off well to be nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 出閘笨拙，居包尾位置。入直路時仍居包尾位置。直路上移出外疊。衝刺良佳。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Bumped shortly after start, raced prominently, 2 wide, found rail 1050M, saved ground on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，居前列，走第二疊。一千零五十米處移入內欄。直路彎走內欄節省腳程。直路初未能再增速。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(+) (2W2W2W3W) Bumped start and unbalanced, raced 2 wide better than midfield, commenced move 400M, finished off well to take 2nd without threatening the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(+)(2W2W2W3W) 起步時被碰撞，失去平衡。居中間之前位置，走第二疊。四百米處開始上前。末段衝刺良佳，跑獲亞軍，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Made contact shortly after start, raced 2 wide behind midfield, 5 lengths back turning in, made minor progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 起步後不久發生觸碰。居中間之後位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後五個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W4W) Raced rear, switched out at the Turn, limited response when placed under pressure (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W4W) 居後列。直路彎向外移出。對催策反應平平。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Began only fairly, raced 2 wide in midfield, similar position on turn, not enough room early in straight, showed limited response thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間位置，走第二疊。直路彎居相若位置。直路早段空位不足，其後對催策反應平平。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Out with rest, raced slightly behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept to inside after straightening and made some progress.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間稍後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。入直路後保持走內疊，略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Sat worse than midfield, not much impression made.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居中間之後位置。無甚表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Crowded shortly after start, rail position in mid-field, driven 500m out, stayed on but lacked pace to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 起步後不久受擠迫，居中間位置，走內欄。五百米處受催策。保持走勢，但速度不足以追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W4W) Prominent early but soon ridden and unable to hold position, towards rear by halfway, well held early in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W4W) 早段居前列，但瞬即受催策，未能保持位置。半程時居後列。直路初落後甚遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Very fast; (2W3W) Settled midfield, limited response when asked.
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
極快步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置。末段對催策反應平平。
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Raced in touch with leaders, driven along 500m out, stayed on well to close on winner late but always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。五百米處受催策。保持佳勢，末段追近頭馬，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, short of room early in home straight, unable to secure clear run until 200m out, ran on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。直路初空位不足，未能望空直至二百米處。末段走勢良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W5W) Dropped out from widest draw, held up last, pushed along widest into home straight, ran on strongly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W5W) 自大外檔出閘後墮後，留居包尾位置。入直路時受推策，走最外疊，最後二百米衝刺強勁。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Settled midfield, traveled only fairly, gave ground inside 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置，走勢僅屬一般。二百米處墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Sat outside the lead, gave ground in the Straight. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居領放馬外側。直路上墮退。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Away well, positioned 1-1/2L behind the leader, same position on turn, kept on well early in straight, peaked near 200M, weakened final 150M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，落後領放馬一個半馬位。直路彎居相同位置。直路早段保持佳勢。接近二百米處時未能再增速。最後一百五十米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W3W) Caught 3 wide no cover on pace, weakened in the Straight. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W3W) 跟隨領放馬，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。直路上轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, blocked off when going for run 600m out, weakened and gave ground final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。六百米處在取位時受困。最後二百米轉弱及墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Pressed leader against rail, quickened early in home straight to lead 300m out, margin reduced closing stages but always doing enough.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 追迫領放馬，走內欄。直路早段加速，三百米處取得領先。末段領先距離收窄，但一直保持佳勢，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Across to press leader, quickened early to lead top of home straight, headed by winner 75m out, stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 切入追迫領放馬。直路初率先加速，取得領先。七十五米處被頭馬超越。末段持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Bumped shortly after start, raced 2 wide better than midfield, 2-1/2L back turning in, kept on same pace in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 起步後不久與對手互相碰撞，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後兩個半馬位。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Moderately away from gate 1, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept on well early in straight, peaked approaching 150M, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘普通，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段保持佳勢，趨近一百五十米處時未能再增速。保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Keen mid-race, settled back into mid-field, under pressure 400m out, weakened.
Substantial blood in trachea.
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 中段搶口，居中間位置。四百米處受催策。轉弱。
氣管內有很多血。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Settle at the rear, picked off a few weakened rivals.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居後列。末段超越數匹已轉弱的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Soon picked up to midfield after moderate start, kept on same pace without quickening in home straight, looked beaten when steadied 150M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 出閘普通後瞬即加速，居中間位置。直路上保持同速，未能加速。一百五十米處在收慢之際看似洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Crowded after sluggish start, raced in rear, headway through field from over 200m out, stayed on, unable to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 出閘緩慢，其後受擠迫，居後列。自二百米處起在馬群中穿插上前。保持走勢。未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced towards rear on the outside, 6 to 7 lengths back turning in, made no impression in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 自外檔出閘後留居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後六至七個馬位。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) Slightly slow out and bumped, positioned 3 lengths behind the leader on the inside, saved ground on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened final furlong.
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 出閘稍慢，發生碰撞，落後領放馬三個馬位，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初未能再增速。最後二百米轉弱。
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; Crowded shortly after start, raced behind midfield on the stands' side, 3 lengths or so back, kept on same pace final 400M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;起步後不久受擠迫。居中間之後位置，落後約三個馬位，靠近外欄競跑。最後四百米保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W4W) Sat midfield 2 wide, made minor headway.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W4W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Bumped start, raced 2 wide behind midfield, 4Ls back, there to turn, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 起步時發生碰撞，居中間之後位置，落後四個馬位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Prominent early, gradually shifted back to worse than midfield in 9th, inconvenienced when tempo slackened 800M out, baulked until clear run 300M out near the centre of the track, ran on steadily to be nearest at finish
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 早段居前列，逐漸墮居中間之後的第九位。八百米處在步速減慢時受妨礙。受困直至三百米處望空，靠近跑道中央競跑。末段以穩勢追前。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; Out with rest, raced behind midfield, nearer to the middle track, 4 lengths back in the middle stages, made no progress final 400M.
(Roarer again.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;與對手同步躍出，居中間之後位置，靠近跑道中央競跑。中段落後四個馬位。最後四百米毫無進展。
（再次患有喘鳴症。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Settled midfield one off the fence, one paced to the finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Very slow; (2W2W) Sat behind midfield 2 wide, made no impression. (See Incident Report)
(Roarer again.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
極慢步速;(2W2W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。毫無表現。（見競賽事件報告。）
（再次患有喘鳴症。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Jumped only fairly, sat midfield, responded well under whip.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間位置。末段對鞭策反應良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Sat midfield on the rail, switched out in the Straight, closed off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。直路上向外移出，末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Crossed gingerly from a wide barrier to share 3L 6th 2-wide onto first bend, gained steadily to within 2L of pace over 700M out, unable to make any further impression in the run to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 自外檔出閘，逐漸切入。開始轉首個彎位時並居第六位，落後三個馬位，走第二疊。穩步上前，七百米處落後領放馬不逾兩個馬位。末段未能進一步追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Three wide in rear of mid-field, taken wider 750m out, unable to get on terms with leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。七百五十米處被帶出更外疊。未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W3W) Settled in front of midfield, raced very wide until 600M, gave ground passing 350M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W3W) 居中間之前位置。六百米處前走大外疊。跑過三百五十米處時墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W2W) Began awkwardly and made contact, raced in midfield on the inside, travelled keenly in the middle stages, 2 to 3 lengths back turning in, kept on evenly in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W2W) 出閘笨拙，與對手互相觸碰，居中間位置，走內疊。中段搶口。入直路時落後兩至三個馬位。直路上保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Moderately away, positioned 2 lengths behind the leader on the middle track, hard ridden from 400M but showed no response, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘普通，落後領放馬兩個馬位，在跑道中央競跑。自四百米處起受力策，但毫無反應。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W4W) Settled behind midfield, caught wide and without cover, weakened in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W4W) 居中間之後位置，走外疊，沒有遮擋。直路上轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W5W) Bumped on jumping, raced towards rear on the outside, no cover throughout, made good progress in straight to be nearest on line. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W5W) 躍出時發生碰撞，居後列，走外疊，沿途沒有遮擋。直路上追前甚多，過終點時最為接近。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Slightly slow out, positioned 3 lengths behind the leader on the inside, similar position on turn, made some progress in straight to take a place, no threat to the first two.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘稍慢，落後領放馬三個馬位，走內疊。直路彎居相若位置。直路上略為追前，取得季軍，但未能威脅頭兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Tracked leaders, driven along to chase leaders 500m out, weakened quickly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹。五百米處受催策以追趕領先馬匹。最後二百米迅速轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W1W) Sat at the rear on the rail, stayed on fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W1W) 居後列，走內欄。保持一般走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W) Dropped in from wide draw, keen mid-race, pushed along over 500m out, no response to pressure, eased when well held 200m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W) 自外檔出閘後移入內疊。中段搶口。五百米處受推策。對催策毫無反應，二百米處落後甚遠時收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Tracked leaders, switched to chase leaders 600m out, dropped away quickly in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。六百米處轉換跑線以追趕領先馬匹。直路上迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (4W2W2W3W) Sat worse than midfield 2 wide, made minor headway in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(4W2W2W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Began well, raced 2 wide slightly behind midfield, wider turning in, made some progress early in straight, no extra final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 出閘迅速，居中間稍後位置，走第二疊。入直路時走較外疊。直路早段略為追前。最後一百五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Began only fairly, raced 2 to 3 wide towards rear of midfield, 6 lengths back turning in, made minor progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走第二至第三疊。入直路時落後六個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped with them, positioned a length behind the leader on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept on well in straight to take 2nd without threatening the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 與對手同步躍出，落後領放馬一個馬位，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上保持佳勢，跑獲亞軍，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Away with them, raced 2 wide in midfield early, 3 wide on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 與對手同步出閘，早段居中間位置，走第二疊。直路彎走第三疊。直路早段未能再增速，其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Shifted out and bumped leaving stalls, tracked leaders against rail, well placed into home straight, weakened final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 出閘時向外斜跑及發生碰撞，跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。入直路時居好位。最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W1W) Made running, pressed on 400m out, headed 200m out, no extra.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W1W) 帶頭競跑。四百米處受催策。二百米處被超越。再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (4W6W) Held up, last and wide into home straight, stayed on final 200m, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(4W6W) 留後。入直路時居包尾位置，走外疊。最後二百米保持走勢。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Away well, raced in midfield on the outside, 3-1/2Ls back turning in, finished off well to take 2nd, always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 出閘迅速，居中間位置，走外疊。入直路時落後三個半馬位。末段衝刺良佳，跑獲亞軍，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W) Sat towards rear, failed to respond when asked, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W) 居後列。對催策毫無反應。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W1W1W) Away with them, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, showed limited response early in straight, weakened final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W1W1W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段對催策反應平平。最後一百五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W3W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced 2 wide, 5 lengths or so back, same margin back turning in, no clear run early in straight, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W3W) 自外檔出閘後留後，落後約五個馬位，走第二疊。入直路時落後相同距離。直路早段未能望空，保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W1W2W3W) Drawn wide, held up last, pushed along from top of home straight, stayed on down the outside, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W1W2W3W) 自大外檔出閘，留居包尾位置。自直路初起受推策。在外疊保持走勢。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Settled in last few, made up good ground in home straight to be nearest at finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居最後數位之內。直路上追前甚多，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W4W) Prominent and wide early after beginning from the widest draw, gradually drifted over 3L back 3-wide 1000M out, gained 6th briefly in a similar position on top of home bend, faded into straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W4W) 自大外檔出閘，早段居前列，走外疊。一千米處逐漸墮退，落後逾三個馬位，走第三疊。直路初居相若位置，一度進佔第六位。入直路時力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Jumped well, raced better than midfield on the outside, no cover throughout, peaked early in straight, kept on same pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走外疊。沿途沒有遮擋。直路初未能再增速。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W1W) Tracked the leader, slightly weakened entering the Straight, kept on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W1W) 跟隨領放馬。入直路時略為轉弱。末段保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W) Sat outside lead, had every chance in the Straight, unable to go pass the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W) 居領放馬外側。直路上一度甚具爭勝機會，但未能超越頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Raced wide without cover, chased along early, driven along 450m out, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 早段追趕領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。四百五十米處受催策。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Began smartly from gate 1, sent forward to take the lead, travelled comfortably to turn, kept on well in straight but unable to hold off the winner final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。直路彎前走勢暢順。直路上保持佳勢，但最後一百米不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Began smartly, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1-1/4L turning in, kept on well early in straight, peaked and headed 150M, weakened gradually close home, just stayed on to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前，取得領先。入直路時領先一又四分一個馬位。直路初保持佳勢。一百五十米處未能再增速，被超越。接近終點時逐漸轉弱，僅能保持走勢，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Began smartly from gate 11, raced prominently, 2 wide, there to turn, kept on well in straight to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 自第十一檔出閘迅速，居前列，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路上保持佳勢，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W1W1W) Began smartly, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground throughout, showed limited response early in straight, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走內疊。沿途走內疊節省腳程。直路早段對催策反應平平。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W3W) Settled midfield on the rail, made steady ground in the straight but had to check at the 150M, not tested thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W3W) 居中間位置，走內欄。直路上穩步上前，但一百五十米處須勒避。其後未能施為。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Sat midfield, made some progress under whip, closed off okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 居中間位置。在鞭策下略為追前。末段衝刺尚可。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W3W) Sat on pace 2 wide, one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W3W) 跟隨領放馬，走第二疊。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Mid-field, once paced under pressure, late gains but never a threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置。在催策下保持同速。末段追前，但從未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W3W) Bumped on jumping, raced 2 wide in midfield, angled out after passing 400M, 4 lengths back turning in, made good progress in straight to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W3W) 躍出時發生碰撞，居中間位置，走第二疊。跑過四百米處後向外移出。入直路時落後四個馬位。直路上追前甚多，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W5W) Settled midfield, traveled fairly, one pace to the finish
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W5W) 居中間位置。走勢一般。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Commenced well, raced in 2nd, 2 wide, there to turn, kept on well early in straight, peaked 200M, weakened gradually final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 出閘迅速。居第二位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路早段保持佳勢。二百米處未能再增速。最後一百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Sat just behind the leaders 2 wide, kept on without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 居領先馬匹稍後位置，走第二疊。末段保持走勢，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W) Showed good speed to lead, kicked 350m out, headed by winner 150m out, flattened out final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W) 展現甚快前速領放。三百五十米處加速。一百五十米處被頭馬超越。最後一百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Tracked leaders out wide, travelled smoothly to 350m out, ran on well final 200m to close on leader but always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走外疊。三百五十米處前走勢暢順。最後二百米以佳勢上前，追近領放馬，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Chased leader against rail, switched to challenge leader on bend, ran on well but headed by winner close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 追趕領放馬，走內欄。直路彎轉換跑線以挑戰領放馬。以佳勢上前，但接近終點時被頭馬超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Began well, raced 2 wide, a length or so back, same position on turn, hard ridden after passing 250M, took the lead 150M, kept on strongly to the line, won by 3 lengths.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，落後約一個馬位，走第二疊。直路彎居相同位置。跑過二百五十米處後受力策。一百五十米處取得領先。保持勁勢至終點，以三個馬位之先勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Tracked leaders against rail, well placed into home straight, dropped away quickly in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。入直路時居好位。直路上迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W4W) Tracked pace in wide position, effort 300m out, no extra final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W4W) 跟隨領放馬，走外疊。三百米處發力。最後一百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W) Sat on pace, traveled okay, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W) 居前列，走勢不俗。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, pressed in front, headed by winner top of home straight, flattened out final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 展現甚佳前速以領放。在領放下受追迫。直路初被頭馬超越。最後二百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Settled in rear of mid-field, ridden to maintain position 700m out, one paced and unable to get on terms with leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 居中間之後位置。七百米處受催策以保持位置。保持同速，未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (3W3W) Bumped shortly after start, under pressure to settle in mid-field, smooth headway and ridden on bend, stayed on well but no match for winner.
(Bled.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(3W3W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，受催策下居中間位置。以暢順走勢上前，直路彎受催策。保持佳勢，但不敵頭馬。
（流鼻血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(-) (2W3W) Tracked pace, keen under restraint and forced to commence move out wide 600m out, good headway to take the lead 300m out, weakened final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(-)(2W3W) 跟隨領放馬。在約束下搶口。六百米處被迫開始上前，走外疊。以佳勢上前，三百米處取得領先。最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Away well, sent forward to take the lead, challenged by rival turning in, peaked and headed 300M, weakened 150M, eased final 50M.
(Near the 350 Metres jockey dropped his whip.)
runnerrecords.incident_eng: (Near the 350 Metres jockey dropped his whip.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。入直路時受對手挑戰。三百米處未能再增速及被超越。一百五十米處轉弱，最後五十米收慢。
（於接近三百五十米處時騎師跌掉馬鞭。）
runnerrecords.incident_chi: （於接近三百五十米處時騎師跌掉馬鞭。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; Shifted out and bumped at start, rear of mid-field, tight for room 250m out, never on terms with leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;起步時向外斜跑，發生碰撞，居中間之後位置。二百五十米處受緊迫。從未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W) Moderately away from the widest draw, raced slightly better than midfield on the outside, no cover for the majority of the race, peaked early in straight, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W) 自最外檔出閘普通，居中間稍前位置，走外疊。大部分途程沒有遮擋。直路早段未能再增速。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Sat on pace on the rail, unable to further quickened in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居前列，走內欄。直路上未能再增速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, well placed into home straight but dropped away quickly, well beaten.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。入直路時居好位，但迅速墮退。末段洩氣潰敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Mid-field towards centre of course, under pressure 400m out, never going pace to get competitive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;居中間位置，靠近跑道中央競跑。四百米處受催策。從未能加速以爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W2W) Slightly slow out, raced 2 wide towards rear, 8-1/2L back turning in, made no progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W2W) 出閘稍慢，居後列，走第二疊。入直路時落後八個半馬位。直路上毫無進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Wide throughout, tracked pace, weakened quickly home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 跟隨領放馬，沿途走外疊。直路上迅速轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W3W5W) Outpaced in rear, pushed along wide into home straight, stayed on but lacked pace to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W3W5W) 居後列，未能跟上步速。入直路時受推策，走外疊。末段保持走勢，但速度不足以追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W1W2W) Rail position in mid-field, angled out to make run 550m out, stayed on well to close on leaders late on but always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W1W2W) 居中間位置，走內欄。五百五十米處向外移出取位。末段保持佳勢，追近領先馬匹，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W1W) Jumped well from inside draw, obtained a position in midfield, 4Ls to make up 400M, stayed on steadily to the finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自最內檔出閘迅速，居中間位置。四百米處落後四個馬位。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W2W4W) Jumped with them, raced 2 wide towards rear, angled out 500M, 7 lengths back turning in, made some progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W2W4W) 與對手同步躍出，居後列，走第二疊。五百米處向外移出。入直路時落後七個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W2W2W7W) Raced in rear, pushed along widest into home straight, passed a few tiring rivals late on, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W2W2W7W) 居後列。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。末段超越數匹已呈疲態的對手，從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W1W2W3W) Sat last, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W1W2W3W) 居包尾位置。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W3W2W3W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced at tail, 8 lengths or so back turning in, passed some tired runners in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W3W2W3W) 自外檔出閘，留居包尾位置。入直路時落後約八個馬位。直路上超越數匹已呈疲態的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W2W3W) Bumped shortly after start, raced 3 wide behind midfield early, 2 wide after entering the back straight, 6 lengths back turning in, failed to close off in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W2W3W) 起步後不久被碰撞，早段居中間之後位置，走第三疊。進入對面直路後走第二疊。入直路時落後六個馬位。直路上衝刺乏力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (3W2W2W2W2W3W) Settled worse than midfield, failed to respond and weakened (Must BT).
(Irregular heart rhythm.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(3W2W2W2W2W3W) 居中間之後位置。對催策毫無反應及轉弱。（必須試閘及格。）
（心律不正常。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W2W) Towards rear of mid-field, stayed on amongst horses final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 居中間之後位置。最後一百五十米在馬匹之間保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W3W) Sat midfield 2 wide, closed off okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。衝刺不俗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (1W1W1W1W) Settled midfield on the rail, saved ground on the turn, closed off nicely, just held on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(1W1W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。直路彎走內欄節省腳程。衝刺良佳，僅勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W2W) Jumped awkwardly, restrained to race in mid-division, held up passing 400M, couldn't quicken enough final 300M and was always held by leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W2W) 出閘笨拙，受約束居中間位置。跑過四百米處時受困。最後三百米加速力不足，一直落後領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W) Mid-field, improved to follow winner through 300m out, stayed on, got up for second late on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W) 居中間位置。上前，三百米處跟隨頭馬推進。保持走勢，末段跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W4W4W) Held up from wide draw, dropped back to race towards the rear 5Ls off the pace, made some inroads towards the finish but failed to seriously threaten at any stage.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W4W4W) 自大外檔出閘後留後，落後領放馬五個馬位。末段略為追前，但從未能構成真正威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W2W2W2W) Sat on pace, raced keenly early, no contention (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W2W2W2W) 居前列。早段搶口。從未參與競逐。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W3W) Chased leaders, raced keenly in the early stages, driven along nearing 400M but soon couldn't keep up with leaders. Out of contention mid-straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 追趕領先馬匹。早段搶口。接近四百米處時受催策，但瞬即未能跟上領先馬匹。直路中段再無爭勝機會。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W3W2W) Bumped out of stalls, chased leader, ridden to press leader 500m out, flattened out final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W3W2W) 出閘時發生碰撞，追趕領放馬。五百米處受催策，追迫領放馬。最後一百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W1W1W1W) Gradually took up running obtaining rails run 1300M out, led the field until headed 150M out, kept on for a place at the finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W1W1W1W) 逐漸取得領先，千三米處移入內欄。持續領先，直至一百五十米處被超越。保持走勢，過終點時跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W1W1W1W) Jumped well, raced in 2nd, 2-1/2L back turning in, showed good response in straight, hit the front 200M, kept on strongly to the line, won by 3 lengths.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，居第二位。入直路時落後兩個半馬位。直路上對催策反應良佳。二百米處取得領先。保持勁勢至終點，以三個馬位之先勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W1W) Tracked the leader, raced keenly in the early stages, gave ground passing 200M (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 跟隨領放馬。早段搶口。跑過二百米處時墮退。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W1W1W1W) Led, gave ground quickly in the Straight, failed to respond (Disappointing Performance, Must BT, See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W1W1W1W) 取得領先。直路上迅速墮退。對催策毫無反應。（表現令人失望。必須試閘及格。見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W2W) Tracked leaders, keen, made effort off final bend, no extra 200m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹，搶口。入直路時發力。最後二百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W2W2W4W) Settled in midfield 5Ls back in a slowly run event, shuffled back to a rearward position from 1000M, held up for clear running 450M to 250M before staying on well to finish 5th. Nearest line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W2W2W4W) 居中間位置，落後五個馬位，賽事步速緩慢。自一千米處起墮居後列。四百五十米處至二百五十米處之間受困而未能望空，其後保持佳勢，跑獲第五名，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W2W) Prominent from a poor draw settling one back 2-wide in 2nd, soon weakened after straightening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 自外檔出閘後居前列第二位，落後一個馬位，走第二疊。入直路後瞬即轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W4W) Moderately away, raced 2 wide behind midfield, very wide turning in, made some progress early in straight, peaked 100M, kept on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W4W) 出閘普通，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。入直路時走大外疊。直路初略為追前。一百米處未能再增速。保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W1W2W2W) Jumped only fairly from a wide draw, dropped back to race at the rear, had big task in hand 400M then ran on fairly well towards the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W1W2W2W) 自外檔出閘僅屬一般，墮居後列。四百米處落後甚遠。末段走勢不俗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W2W2W2W) Broke well from a poor draw settling in last few, made rapid progress inside the 900M to share the lead 700M out, came under pressure to hold place rounding home bend and into straight, unable to sustain effort inside final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W2W2W2W) 自外檔出閘迅速，居最後數位之內。九百米處迅速上前，七百米處並排領先。轉直路彎及入直路時在催策下保持位置。最後一百五十米無以為繼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast(-) (1W1W1W1W) Jumped well, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1-1/4L turning in, kept on well early in straight, peaked and headed 150M, weakened final 100M.
(Lame in right front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速(-)(1W1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先一又四分一個馬位。直路早段保持佳勢，一百五十米處未能再增速及被超越，最後一百米轉弱。
（右前腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Made running, ridden and kicked two lengths clear top of home straight, ran on well and unchallenged from there.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 領放。直路初受催策，加速帶離兩個馬位。自該處起走勢良佳，未受挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Began smartly, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1/2L turning in, kept on well in straight but unable to hold off the winner final 50M, just beaten by a narrow margin.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。轉入直路時領先半個馬位。直路上保持佳勢，但最後五十米不敵頭馬，僅以短距離見負。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W2W2W2W) Moderately away from gate 13, sent forward to race prominently on the outside, peaked 200M, weakened gradually final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W2W2W2W) 自第十三檔出閘普通，受催策上前，居前列，走外疊。二百米處未能再增速。最後一百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (2W2W) Always thereabouts, hit the front shortly after straightening and led until overhauled by fast-finishing winner 150M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(2W2W) 沿途居啣接位置。入直路後不久取得領先，直至一百五十米處被衝刺強勁的頭馬超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W1W) Sent forward to lead, weakened final furlong. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W1W) 受催策上前領放。最後二百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (4W3W2W2W) Pressed forward from a poor draw travelling wide around first bend, settled 2-wide just outside race leader in back straight, fought on steadily under pressure but lost 2nd late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(4W3W2W2W) 自外檔出閘後受催策上前。轉首個彎位時走外疊。對面直路上居領放馬外側，走第二疊。在催策下持續力拼，但末段失去亞席。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W4W) Away with them, raced 2 wide behind midfield early, positioned 3 wide in midfield after passing 1000M, 4 wide turning in, took the lead 200M, kept on well to the line. (Finished 1st, demoted to 2nd.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W4W) 與對手同步出閘，早段居中間之後位置，走第二疊。跑過一千米處後居中間位置，走第三疊。入直路時走第四疊。二百米處取得領先。保持佳勢至終點。（以第一名衝線，被貶為亞軍。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W2W) Box seat, ridden along to chase leaders 500m out, stayed on well to close on winner late on but always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W2W) 居包廂位置。五百米處在催策下追趕領先馬匹。末段以佳勢追近頭馬，但一直未能超越該駒。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Sent forward to lead, kept on until weakened final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 受催策上前領放。保持走勢，最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(-) (3W4W) Caught racing wide no cover in midfield, moved up 600M to be tracking the pace turning into straight, kept on steadily to go 2nd mid-straight, no match for the runaway winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(-)(3W4W) 居中間位置，走外疊，沒有遮擋。六百米處上前，轉入直路時跟隨領放馬。保持穩勢，直路中段進佔第二位，但不敵遙遙領先的頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W1W3W) Bumped shortly after start, positioned 1 to 2 lengths behind the leader on the inside, angled out approaching 450M, showed very good response in straight, took the lead 200M, kept on well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W1W3W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，落後領放馬一至兩個馬位，走內疊。趨近四百五十米處時向外移出。直路上對催策反應甚佳，二百米處取得領先，保持佳勢至終點，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W3W) Raced in touch with leaders, effort entering home straight, unable to challenge winner but stuck to task for clear second.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。入直路時發力。未能挑戰頭馬，但持續力拼，帶離餘駒跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W4W2W) Jumped with them, raced 2 wide in midfield, improved after passing 800M, challenged the leader turning in, kept on well in straight to take 2nd, always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W4W2W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間位置，走第二疊。跑過八百米處後推進。入直路時挑戰領放馬。直路上保持佳勢，獲得亞軍，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W2W2W) Sat on pace 2 wide, unable to further quickened in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W2W2W) 居前列，走第二疊。直路上未能進一步加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W3W3W) Mid-field, wide final bend, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W3W3W) 居中間位置。入直路時走外疊。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Pressed forward from a poor draw to be prominent and wide without cover home bend, folded up quickly in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 自外檔出閘，受催策上前，居前列。直路彎走外疊，沒有遮擋。直路上迅速力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W3W2W2W) Sat on pace, angled out from 1500M and led passing 1200M, gave ground quickly in the Straight (Disappointing Performance, Must BT, See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W3W2W2W) 居前列。自千五米處起向外移出，跑過千二米處時帶頭。直路上迅速墮退。（表現令人失望。必須試閘及格。見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Away well, raced 2 wide better than midfield, angled out 550M, took the lead 300M, kept on well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。五百五十米處向外移出。三百米處取得領先。保持佳勢至終點，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W2W2W) Wide early, taken forward and raced prominently, ridden to lead 200m out, stayed on well to hold on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W2W2W) 早段走外疊，受催策上前，居前列。二百米處在催策下取得領先。保持佳勢，保住勝果。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W3W4W) Jumped with them, raced 2 wide in midfield, 3 wide from 650M, closer on turn, kept on well in straight but always just held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W3W4W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間位置，走第二疊。自六百五十米處起走第三疊。直路彎追近。直路上保持佳勢，但一直以些微距離落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Moderately away from gate 1, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground throughout, not enough room until 150M, kept on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘普通，居中間位置，走內疊。沿途走內疊節省腳程。空位不足直至一百五十米處。保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W5W) Guided to a position behind midfield, raced keenly early stages then swung wide over the home turn, failed to pick up pace on straightening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W5W) 居中間之後位置，早段搶口。直路彎移出外疊。入直路時未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W1W2W) Began well from gate 1, raced slightly better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, finished off strongly to score by a neck.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W1W2W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居中間稍前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。末段衝刺強勁，以一馬頸之先勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W2W) Mid-field, one paced under pressure and unable to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W2W) 居中間位置。在催策下保持同速，未能展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W3W) Sat towards the rear, picked off a few weakened rivals.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居後列。末段超越數匹已轉弱的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W4W) Made contact at start, raced at rear on the outside, 6 lengths or so back turning in, failed to make any progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W4W) 起步時與對手互相觸碰，居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後約六個馬位。直路上毫無進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Tightened at start and soon dropped to the rear, never seen with a chance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 起步時受緊迫，瞬即墮居後列。從未看似有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (1W1W1W1W) Mid-field, opened up for him towards rail entering home straight, chased leader, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(1W1W1W1W) 居中間位疊。入直路時沿欄出現空位，追趕領放馬，保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W2W3W) Bumped shortly after start, tracked leaders, under pressure from halfway to hold position, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W2W3W) 起步後不久與對手互相碰撞，跟隨領先馬匹。自半程起受催策以保持位置。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W3W3W) Mid-field, wide throughout, stayed on final 200m, no threat to winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W3W3W) 居中間位置。沿途走外疊。最後二百米保持走勢，未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (1W1W1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, switched for clear run 400m out, ran on well final 200m, closed on winner but always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(1W1W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。四百米處轉換跑線以望空。最後二百米保持佳勢。末段追近頭馬，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W4W) Sat midfield 2 wide, made good late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W4W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。末段追前甚多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W2W3W4W) Waited with towards rear, pushed along wide into home straight, never on terms with leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W2W3W4W) 居後列，留力候上。入直路時受推策，走外疊。從未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Shifted in and bumped leaving stalls, in rear, forced to steady on heels 500m out, made up some late ground.
(Respiratory condition.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘時向內斜跑及與對手互相碰撞，居後列。五百米處被迫收慢避開對手的後蹄。末段略為追前。
（異常呼吸狀況。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W6W) Jumped only fairly, settled in front of midfield, traveled fairly, raced very wide throughout, limited response when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W6W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之前位置。走勢一般。沿途走大外疊。對催策反應平平。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (1W1W) Sat worse than midfield on the rail, stayed on okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。末段保持不俗走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W4W) Jumped fairly, given a reserved ride near the rear, still 8Ls to make up 400M, closed off moderately to claim 5th but was never likely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W4W) 出閘一般，居後列，留力候上。四百米處仍落後八個馬位。衝刺普通，取得第五名，但從未有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced behind midfield on the outside, slightly improved on turn, showed limited response early in straight, weakened inside final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W) 自大外檔出閘，留居中間之後位置，走外疊。直路彎略為推進上前。直路早段對催策反應平平。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W2W) Crowded shortly after start, raced 2 wide slightly behind midfield, 4 lengths back turning in, one-paced in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W2W) 起步後不久受擠迫，居中間稍後位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後四個馬位。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Very fast; (3W2W2W4W) Jumped only fairly, settled handy, failed to respond when asked (See Incident Report).
(Lame in right hind leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
極快步速;(3W2W2W4W) 出閘僅屬一般，居前列。對催策毫無反應。（見競賽事件報告。）
（右後腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W3W) Began only fairly, raced 2 wide at rear, 6 to 7 lengths back turning in, made minor progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W3W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列，走第二疊。入直路時落後六至七個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced towards rear on the inside, moved a bit closer along the rail on turn, no clear run until approaching final 100M, finished off well to make frame.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自大外檔出閘後留居後列，走內疊。直路彎沿欄略為追近。未能望空直至趨近一百米處。衝刺良佳，取得第四名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W3W5W) Made contact shortly after start, raced 2 wide behind midfield early, 3 wide from 1200M, 4-1/2L back turning in, made good progress in straight to take 2nd without threatening the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W3W5W) 起步後不久發生觸碰，早段居中間之後位置，走第二疊。自千二米處起走第三疊。入直路時落後四個半馬位。直路上追前頗多，跑獲亞軍，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W2W) Tracked leader, driven along 400m out to chase leader, dropped away quickly in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 跟隨領放馬。四百米處在催策下追趕領放馬。直路上迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Settled midfield on the rail, angled out rounding the Home Turn, closed off okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。轉直路彎時向外移出。末段衝刺尚可。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W2W4W) Settled behind midfield 2 wide, stayed on nicely.
