runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W2W4W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W1W1W1W) Dipped when leaving the stalls, waited with in rear, unable to find clear room until 100m, hit the line nicely once clear.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W1W1W1W) 出閘時將頭低俯，居後列，留力候上。未能望空直至一百米處，望空後隨即以佳勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (3W2W3W4W) Commenced well, raced 2 wide behind midfield, moved closer after passing 600M, 4 lengths or so back turning in, made good progress in straight to make frame.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(3W2W3W4W) 出閘迅速，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。跑過六百米處後追近。入直路時落後約四個馬位。直路上追前甚多，取得第四名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W3W) Sat worse than midfield, traveled fairly, limited response when asked (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居中間之後位置，走勢一般。末段對催策反應平平。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast; (3W3W3W4W) Moderately away from a tricky draw, raced 3 wide better than midfield, no cover throughout, peaked 500M, weakened thereafter.
(Bled.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速;(3W3W3W4W) 自第九檔出閘普通，居中間之前位置，走第三疊。沿途沒有遮擋。五百米處未能再增速，其後轉弱。
（流鼻血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W2W) Raced on outside of leader, outpaced and unable to stay with that rival 350m out, no extra late and lost third.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 居領放馬外側。三百五十米處被拋離，未能跟上該駒。末段再無餘力，失去季席。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W1W) Settled in front of midfield on the rail, made minor ground on the inside.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居中間之前位置，走內欄。末段在內疊略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Crowded and bumped at start, settled in mid-field, unable to pick up for pressure from 400m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 起步時受擠迫及發生碰撞，居中間位置。自四百米處起在催策下未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W) Bumped start, raced better than midfield on the outside, 2-1/2L back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W) 起步時發生碰撞，居中間之前位置，走外疊。入直路時落後兩個半馬位。直路初未能再增速。其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Crowded at start, dropped to rear on bend, pushed along wide into home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 出閘時受擠迫。直路彎墮退至後列。入直路時受推策，走外疊。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Taken back from gate 11, raced at rear, 5 lengths or so back, there to turn, finished off very strongly to score by a head.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 自第十一檔出閘後留居後列，落後約五個馬位。直路彎前居相同位置。衝刺凌厲，以一馬頭位之先掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Moderately away, raced behind midfield on the inside, moved a bit closer on turn, finished off well to take 2nd without threatening the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘普通，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎略為追近。衝刺良佳，取得亞軍，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W1W1W) Slowly away, raced at rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, made no progress in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W1W1W) 出閘緩慢，居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上毫無進展。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W) Sat midfield 2 wide, closed off okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。末段衝刺尚可。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W) Settled at the rear 3 wide, never in contention. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W) 居後列，走第三疊。從未參與競逐。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Moderate start, gradually recovered along rail to be up with the pace after the first 200M, shifted 2L back to 4th 600M out on top of home bend, renewed effort inside final 200M but never threatened the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 起步普通，其後沿欄逐漸恢復走勢，過了首二百米後跟上步速。六百米處直路彎早段居第四位，落後兩個馬位。最後二百米重新發力，但從未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Taken back from gate 12, raced at rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, checked 200M, kept on same pace to the line. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自第十二檔出閘，留居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。二百米處勒避。保持同速至終點。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Stumbled leaving stalls, tracked leaders, ridden along 500m out, dropped away quickly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 出閘時失蹄，跟隨領先馬匹。五百米處受催策。最後二百米迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Travelled alongside wire-to-wire winner early stages, shifted in for rails run in 2nd onto home bend, given reminders to hold place upon straightening but swamped inside final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 早段與一放到底的頭馬並跑。開始轉直路彎時移入內欄，居第二位。入直路時受鞭策以保持位置，但最後一百五十米被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W1W1W) Rail position in rear of mid-field, under pressure 400m out, dropped away quickly in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。四百米處受催策。直路上迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W2W) Moved up to press leader on outside, ran home one paced early straight, lost 2nd inside 200M and weakened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W2W) 上前追迫領放馬，走外疊。直路早段保持同速。最後二百米失去第二位及轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Shifted out at start and bumped, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1/4L turning in, kept on well early in straight, peaked and headed 150M, weakened gradually final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 起步時向外斜跑及被碰撞，受催策上前取得領先。入直路時領先四分一個馬位。直路初保持佳勢。一百五十米處未能再增速，被超越。最後五十米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Began well, raced 2 wide in midfield, 3 lengths back turning in, no clear run until 200M, blocked again 150M, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 出閘迅速，居中間位置，走第二疊。轉入直路時落後三個馬位。未能望空直至二百米處。一百五十米處再度受阻，其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W5W) Jumped well from gate 9, taken back to race behind midfield on the outside, 6 to 7 lengths back turning in, made minor progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W5W) 自第九檔出閘迅速，留居中間之後位置，走外疊。入直路時落後六至七個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W3W) Dropped out from widest draw, didn't travel with much fluency early stages, pushed along wide into home straight, passed a few tiring rivals.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W3W) 自最外檔出閘後墮後，早段走勢欠順。入直路時受推策，走外疊。末段超越數匹漸呈疲態的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W3W) Clumsy start losing ground, soon recovered to forward of midfield on rail some 3L off the pace in 5th, angled out for a run entering straight but unable to quicken to threaten, hampered and faded 50M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W3W) 出閘笨拙，失地，瞬即恢復走勢，居中間之前第五位，落後領放馬約三個馬位，走內欄。進入直路時向外移出取位，但未能加速以構成威脅。受阻礙，五十米處力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) In midfield early stages before moving closer to track leaders entering home turn, driven final 200M and went to the line well. (Jockey - requested to take up a forward position from wide draw.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 早段居中間位置。入直路彎時追近，跟隨領先馬匹。最後二百米受催策。末段衝刺良佳。（騎師表示，他獲指示讓自外檔出閘的坐騎佔取前列位置。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Soon dropped to last few, saved ground turning in for home, ran on steadily in straight, never nearer.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 瞬即墮居最後數位之內。入直路時走內疊節省腳程。直路上穩步上前。以末段最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Tracked leaders, tended to hang right throughout, faded final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;跟隨領先馬匹。沿途傾向內閃。最後一百米力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W) Began from the widest barrier settling wide without cover in rear of midfield, slightly worse towards rear rounding home bend and into straight, kept on steadily down the centre of the track.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W) 自大外檔出閘，居中間之後位置，走外疊，沒有遮擋。轉直路彎及入直路時略為墮後，居後列。末段保持穩勢，在跑道中央競跑。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Raced on outside of field from low draw, good headway from 300m out despite edging left, led 50m out, cosy winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;自第一檔出閘，居馬群外側競跑。自三百米處起儘管外閃，但追前甚多。五十米處取得領先，輕鬆取勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Chased leader, pushed along 400m out, weakened final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;追趕領放馬。四百米處受推策。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Ridden hard to lead, weakened notably inside 300M, failed to respond.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 在力策下取得領先。最後三百米顯著轉弱。對催策毫無反應。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W3W) Ridden along from a poor draw to be up with the pace 5-wide, closer to rail 3-wide rounding home bend and shared 2nd into straight, unable to sustain effort inside final 300M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W3W) 自外檔出閘，受催策，跟隨領放馬，走第五疊。轉直路彎時移近內欄，走第三疊。入直路時並居第二位。最後三百米無以為繼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Chased leader, tight for room against rail and had to switch 200m out, stayed on at the one pace after.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 追趕領放馬。沿欄受緊迫，二百米處須轉換跑線，其後保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Raced prominently, led briefly 200m out, stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 居前列。二百米處一度領先。持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W1W1W) Started well and led, pressed on 300m out, headed over 100m out, no extra.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W1W1W) 出閘迅速，領放。三百米處受追迫。一百米處被超越。末段再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W) Soon took up running with rails run holding narrow advantage to 300M, fought on under pressure until swamped for a placing final stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W) 瞬即帶頭競跑，走內欄。以短距離領先直至三百米處。在催策下持續力拼，末段被後上馬匹過頭，失去位置。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, ridden along 300m out, headed by winner 150m out, stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 展現甚快前速，取得領先。三百米處受催策。一百五十米處被頭馬超越。持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W1W) Began from the middle draw to make all, taking advantage of the slow early tempo to obtain rails run over 800M out, driven over 2L clear briefly inside the 150M, won cozily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W1W) 自中檔出閘，一放到底。利用賽事早段慢步速的優勢，八百米處佔取內欄位置。受催策，一百五十米處一度帶離逾兩個馬位。從容取勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Chased leader, every chance 300m out, faded final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 追趕領放馬。三百米處一度甚具爭勝機會。最後二百米力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, ridden top of home straight, headed by winner 200m out, sticking to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 展現甚快前速以領放。直路初受催策。二百米處被頭馬超越。持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Jumped well and led, kept on nicely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，領放。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Taken back from gate 12, raced at rear, 8-1/2L back turning in, made very good progress in straight to take a place, nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 自第十二檔起步後留居後列。入直路時落後八個半馬位。直路上追前甚多，取得季軍，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W1W1W) Sat midfield on the rail, made no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Tracked leader, no extra and lost ground final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 跟隨領放馬。最後一百五十米再無餘力及失地。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (3W1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, challenged up rail from 300m out, strong run to lead 100m out, won cosily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(3W1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。自三百米處起沿欄展開挑戰。走勢強勁，一百米處取得領先。輕鬆取勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W3W) Sat last, limited response when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W3W) 居包尾位置。對催策反應平平。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W2W2W) Sat last, made no ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W2W2W) 居尾列。未能追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) Tracked pace, ridden to hold position from 400m out, no extra final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 跟隨領放馬。自四百米處起在催策下保持位置。最後一百五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Towards rear, stayed on inside rail, unable to pick up for pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居後列，固守內欄。受催策，但未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W2W2W) Pressed forward around first bend to join leaders 3-wide, obtained 2-wide position 800M out, faded steadily out of contention after straightening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W2W2W) 受催策上前。首次轉彎時追上領先馬匹，走第三疊。八百米處走第二疊。入直路後逐漸力竭，再無爭勝機會。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Away with them, raced 2 wide in midfield, wider turning in, kept on same pace in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間位置，走第二疊。入直路時走較外疊。直路上保持同速。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W1W) Sent forward to lead, kept on until weakened in the final strides. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W1W) 受催策上前領放。保持走勢，直至最後數步轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Very slow; (5W4W) Tracked pace three wide, keen, brief effort early in home straight, soon weakened.
(Lame in left hind leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
極慢步速;(5W4W) 跟隨領放馬，走第三疊。搶口。直路早段一度發力，瞬即轉弱。
（左後腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Began only fairly, raced 2 wide behind midfield, 5 lengths back turning in, no daylight early in straight, made good progress final 200M to take 2nd, no threat to the winner. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後五個馬位。直路初未能望空。最後二百米追前頗多，跑獲亞軍，但未能威脅頭馬。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W) Settled on the rail behind the pacemaker, saved ground to turn, kept on one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W) 居領放馬之後，走內欄。直路彎前走內欄節省腳程。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (3W2W3W) Out with rest, raced 2 wide in midfield, 4 lengths or so back turning in, taken wide in straight and finished off strongly, just beaten by a head, good debut.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(3W2W3W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後約四個馬位。直路上移出外疊。末段衝刺強勁。僅以一馬頭位之差落敗，首戰表現良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Jumped cleanly, settled ahead of midfield never far off from leaders, quickened up well in the straight to chase eventual winner. Lost 3rd spot late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 出閘俐落，居中間之前位置，從未遠離領先馬匹。直路上加速良佳，追趕頭馬。末段失去季席。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W4W) Moderately away, raced 3 wide slightly behind midfield, 3 lengths or so back turning in, showed some response early in straight, peaked 100M, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W4W) 出閘普通，居中間稍後位置，走第三疊。入直路時落後約三個馬位。直路初對催策略為交出反應。一百米處未能再增速。保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Tracked pace, no extra and losing ground when becoming unbalanced 50m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;跟隨領放馬。五十米處在失去平衡之際再無餘力及失地。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Sat behind midfield, traveled okay, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居中間之後位置，走勢尚可。保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (2W3W) Raced in touch, good headway to challenge leader 100m out, held final 50m but clear of remainder.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。以佳勢上前，一百米處挑戰領放馬。最後五十米落後，但拋離其他對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W5W) Settled towards the rear 2 wide, angled out in the Straight, closed off nicely for 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W5W) 居後列，走第二疊。直路上向外移出。衝刺良佳，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Soon taken back towards rear from a poor draw, travelled 3-wide around home bend and into straight, responded well inside final 300M to prevail near the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 自第十三檔出閘後瞬即留居後列。轉直路彎及入直路時走第三疊。最後三百米對催策反應良佳，接近終點時取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to slow; (3W3W) Dropped out from widest draw, wide into home straight, unable to improve position.
Respiratory condition.
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏慢步速;(3W3W) 自大外檔出閘後墮後。入直路時走外疊。其後未能推進。
異常呼吸狀況。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; Bumped leaving stalls, rear of mid-field against far rail, ridden along halfway out, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;出閘時與對手互相碰撞，居中間之後位置，走外欄。半程時受催策。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Towards rear of mid-field on outer, pushed along 400m out, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;居中間之後位置，離外欄競跑。四百米處受推策。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Very slow; (2W2W2W) Jumped well, raced 2 wide slightly behind midfield, difficult to settle throughout, made contact 400M, showed limited response in straight, steadied near 100M, weakened gradually close home. (See Racing Incidents.)
Roarer.
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
極慢步速;(2W2W2W) 出閘迅速，居中間稍後位置，走第二疊。沿途難以穩定走勢。接近四百米處時發生觸碰。直路上對催策反應平平。接近一百米處時收慢。接近終點時逐漸轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）
患有喘鳴症。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Dropped in from wide draw, short of room briefly 450m out, still in rear top of home straight, limited late headway.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 自外檔出閘後墮後移入。四百五十米處一度空位不足。直路初仍居後列。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W2W) Taken back to race 2 wide behind midfield, 5 lengths or so back, there to turn, made no progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W2W) 留居中間之後位置，落後約五個馬位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路上毫無進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (3W2W3W) Sat towards the rear 2 wide, made no impression.
(Roarer.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(3W2W3W) 居後列，走第二疊。毫無表現。
（患有喘鳴症。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W3W) Waited with in rear, pushed along widest into home straight, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W3W) 居後列，留力候上。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W4W) Soon dropped to last few racing wide throughout despite ridden along, last rounding home bend, never seen with a chance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W4W) 瞬即墮居最後數位之內。儘管受催策，但沿途走外疊。轉直路彎時居包尾位置。從未看似有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Average to begin, raced 2 wide slightly behind midfield, 3 to 4 lengths back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 出閘普通，居中間稍後位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後三至四個馬位。直路初未能再增速，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W2W2W) Settled midfield 2 wide, weakened in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W2W2W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。直路上轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W1W) Broke well from a wide barrier and soon taken back to last few, became last on straightening despite saving ground on rail, soon detached.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W1W) 自外檔出閘迅速，瞬即留居最後數位之內。入直路時雖走內欄節省腳程，但居包尾位置。瞬即被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W2W) Taken back from wide draw, last and pushed along into home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W2W) 自外檔出閘後留後。入直路時居包尾位置，受推策。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W3W) Held up last, ridden along middle stages to catch up to main body, eased once well held in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W3W) 留居包尾位置。中段受催策以追上主馬群。直路上遙遙落後時隨即收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) Bumped shortly after start, raced behind the leader on the inside, peaked on turn, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 起步後不久與對手互相碰撞，居領放馬之後，走內疊。直路彎未能再增速。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W5W) Jumped with them, raced 2 wide behind midfield, angled out 500M, showed good response in straight, bumped near 150M, kept on well to the line, just beaten by a narrow margin.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W5W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。五百米處向外移出。直路上對催策反應良佳。接近一百五十米處時發生碰撞。保持佳勢至終點，僅以短距離之差落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W3W4W) Out with rest, raced 3 wide with cover in midfield, wider turning in, weakened early in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W3W4W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。入直路時走更外疊。直路早段轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W1W) Made contact at start, sat 1 to 2 lengths behind the leader on rail, saved ground on turn, took the lead 150M, kept on well but unable to hold off the winner close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 起步時發生觸碰，落後領放馬一至兩個馬位，走內欄。直路彎走內欄節省腳程。一百五十米處取得領先，末段保持佳勢，但接近終點時未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W3W4W) Tracked pace, three wide, ridden and quickly lost position turning into home straight, soon well held and eased.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W3W4W) 跟隨領放馬，走第三疊。轉入直路時受催策，但迅速失位。瞬即被拋離，收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Clean jump, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, showed very good response in straight, hit the front approaching 50M, kept on well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘俐落，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上對催策反應甚佳。趨近五十米處時取得領先。保持佳勢至終點，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W3W3W) Clean jump, raced 2 wide in midfield, 3 wide turning in, made minor progress early in straight, peaked 100M, ran on evenly to the line. (2nd last start.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W3W3W) 出閘俐落，居中間位置，走第二疊。入直路時走第三疊。直路初略為追前。一百米處未能再增速。保持穩勢至終點。（上仗跑獲亞軍。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (4W3W3W5W) Settled towards the rear 3 wide, stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(4W3W3W5W) 居後列，走第三疊。保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W3W3W7W) Began well from gate 11, raced behind midfield on the outside, very wide turning in, made good progress in straight, nearest finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W3W3W7W) 自第十一檔出閘迅速，居中間之後位置，走外疊。入直路時走大外疊。直路上追前甚多，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Away in line, restrained to race in midfield along the fence, responded only fairly in the straight. Never reached contention.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 與對手同步出閘，受約束，居中間位置，走內欄。直路上對催策反應僅屬一般。從未能參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Jumped well from the widest draw, sent forward to take the lead, shared lead with rival on turn, peaked and headed 250M, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 自大外檔出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。直路彎與對手並排領先。二百五十米處未能再增速及被超越，最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W3W4W) Tracked pace out wide without cover, driven along 400m out, weakened quickly in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W3W4W) 跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。四百米處受催策。直路上迅速轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Bumped start, raced in 2nd, 2 wide, there to turn, peaked early in straight, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 起步時發生碰撞，居第二位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路初未能再增速，最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W3W3W) Prominent early, 3-wide without cover rounding first bend, just over 2L off the pace in 4th in back straight, gave ground under pressure inside final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W3W3W) 早段居前列。首次轉彎時走第三疊，沒有遮擋。對面直路上居第四位，落後領放馬稍逾兩個馬位。最後二百米在催策下墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Bumped on jumping, ended up racing behind mid-division, failed to respond when driven along 400M. (No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 躍出時發生碰撞，居中間之後位置。四百米處對催策毫無反應。（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Crowded at start from a wide barrier settling in last few, saved ground turning in for home but did not find much room early in straight, kept on under pressure inside final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 自外檔起步時受擠迫，居最後數位之內。轉入直路時走內欄節省腳程，但直路早段空位不足。最後二百米在催策下保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Slowly away settling at the back, saved ground on rail turning in for home, ran past beaten horses in the run to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘緩慢，居後列。入直路時走內欄節省腳程。末段超越已洩氣潰敗的馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W4W) Began only fairly, raced in second half of the field along the 3-path, driven 500M but couldn't quicken, never able to challenge. (No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W4W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後半馬群中，走第三疊。五百米處受催策但未能加速。從未能作出挑戰。（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W1W1W1W) Dropped out from widest draw, outpaced and left behind final 500m, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W1W1W1W) 自最外檔出閘後墮後。未能跟上步速，最後五百米被拋離。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Jumped awkwardly and lost ground, recovered to race behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened final 300M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘笨拙及失地，恢復走勢，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段未能再增速。最後三百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Slowly into stride, towards rear, left behind final 300m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 展步緩慢，居後列。最後三百米被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Towards rear after slow start, stayed on into mid-field but never going pace to get competitive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 起步緩慢，居後列。末段保持走勢，進佔中間位置，但從未能加速以爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Waited with towards rear, had to wait for run turning into home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居後列，留力候上。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W3W) Settled towards the rear, failed to respond from home turn and soon out of contention. Finished tailed out. (Jockey - failed to travel at any stage of the event / No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居後列。自直路彎起對催策毫無反應，瞬即再無爭勝機會。包尾大敗而回。（騎師表示，坐騎全程走勢欠佳。）（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) From wide draw taken back to last, over 10Ls off the pace in middle stages, got left behind turning home. Soundly beaten. (No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 自外檔出閘後留居包尾位置。中段落後領放馬逾十個馬位。轉入直路時被拋離。大敗而回。（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, ridden to hold position from 500m out, no extra final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。自五百米處起受催策以保持位置。最後二百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W3W) Settled in mid-field, struggled to hold position final bend, eased when detached 100m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居中間位置。直路彎難以保持位置。一百米處被拋離時收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Jumped well, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1/2L turning in, peaked and headed 200M, weakened gradually final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先半個馬位。二百米處未能再增速，被超越。最後五十米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Jumped well, sent forward to take the lead, led by 3/4L turning in, kept on very well in straight, won by 2 lengths.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先四分三個馬位。直路上保持甚佳走勢，以兩個馬位之先勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast; (2W2W2W2W) Jumped with them, raced in 2nd, 2 wide, there to turn, peaked early in straight, weakened final furlong. (See Racing Incidents.)
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 與對手同步躍出，居第二位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路早段未能再增速，最後二百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W2W2W1W) Sat behind the pace 2 wide, kept on strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W2W2W1W) 居領放馬之後，走第二疊。保持強勁走勢，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W3W3W3W) Caught 3 wide with cover off pace, nothing extra in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W3W3W3W) 居領放馬之後，走第三疊，有遮擋。直路上再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (5W4W3W4W) Settled midfield 3 wide with some cover, stayed on well, no threat to the first few.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(5W4W3W4W) 居中間位置，走第三疊，略有遮擋。保持佳勢，但未能威脅首數名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W1W1W) Moderately away from a wide draw, raced 2 wide better than midfield, found rail near 1000M, saved ground on turn, hit the front 150M, kept on well but unable to hold off the first two close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W1W1W) 自外檔出閘普通，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。接近一千米處時移入內欄。直路彎走內欄疊節省腳程。一百五十米處取得領先。保持佳勢，但接近終點時未能抗衡首兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W2W) Average to begin, raced 2 wide better than midfield, there to turn, showed limited response early in straight, weakened final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W2W) 出閘普通，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路早段對催策反應平平。最後一百五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W3W) Commenced well, raced 2 wide better than midfield, 3 wide turning in, kept on evenly in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W3W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。入直路時走第三疊。直路上保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast; (2W2W2W3W) Made contact at start, raced 2 wide slightly better than midfield, moved closer after passing 600M, 2 lengths or so back turning in, kept on evenly in straight.
(Jockey dropped whip at 250M.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 起步時發生觸碰，居中間稍前位置，走第二疊。跑過六百米處後追近。入直路時落後約兩個馬位，直路上保持穩勢。
（於二百五十米處騎師跌掉馬鞭。）
runnerrecords.incident_chi: （於二百五十米處騎師跌掉馬鞭。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(-) (1W1W1W1W) Jumped well and was sent forward, led, kept on until weakened final 100M. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(-)(1W1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前，取得領先。保持走勢直至最後一百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W3W3W3W) Caught 3 wide no cover on pace, gave ground in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W3W3W3W) 居前列，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。直路上墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W6W) Waited with towards rear, pushed along widest into home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W6W) 居後列，留力候上。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W2W3W) Shifted out and made contact out of stalls, mid division, forced to steady on heels 1500m out, effort 300m out, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W2W3W) 出閘時向外斜跑，與對手互相觸碰，居中間位置。千五米處被迫收慢避開對手的後蹄。三百米處發力上前。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W2W) Slowly away, raced behind midfield on the inside, 2 wide turning in, made no progress in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W2W) 出閘緩慢，居中間之後位置，走內疊。入直路時走第二疊。直路上毫無進展。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W2W) Slowly away, positioned 5 lengths behind the leader on rail, wider turning in, one-paced in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W2W) 出閘緩慢，落後領放馬五個馬位，走內欄。入直路時走較外疊，末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Slowly away, rail position in rear of mid-field, clear run up rail from 400m out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘緩慢，居中間之後位置，走內欄。自四百米處起沿欄望空。速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Sat towards the rear on the rail, made no ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居後列，走內欄。末段毫無進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W3W) Sat at the rear, made no impression. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居後列。毫無表現。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W3W6W) Slow to begin, raced towards rear on the outside, very wide turning in, made some headway in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W3W6W) 出閘緩慢，居後列，走外疊。轉入直路時走大外疊。直路上略為追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W1W4W) Slow to begin, raced behind midfield on the inside, commenced move approaching 600M, 6 lengths back turning in, finished off well to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W1W4W) 出閘緩慢，居中間之後位置，走內疊。趨近六百米處時開始上前。入直路時落後六個馬位。衝刺良佳，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W4W) Sat off pace 2 wide, one pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W4W) 居領放馬之後，走第二疊。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Broke well from a wide barrier travelling one back 3-wide without cover early stages, made swift headway inside the 1000M to lead rounding home bend, found no extra and swamped inside final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 自外檔出閘迅速，早段落後一個馬位，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。一千米處迅速上前，轉直路彎時取得領先。最後一百米再無餘力及被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Wide in mid-field, headway 400m out, flattened out final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置，走外疊。四百米處追前。最後二百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Sluggish start, shifted in and bumped out of stalls, in rear, good headway 500m out, unable to get on terms with leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;出閘緩慢，向內斜跑，與對手互相碰撞，居後列。五百米處追前甚多，但未能追近領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W3W) Very slowly away, raced at rear on the inside, a bit closer in the middle stages, angled out after passing 500M, made some progress early in straight, no clear run inside final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W3W) 出閘十分緩慢，居包尾位置，走內疊。中段略為追近。跑過五百米處後向外移出。直路早段略為追前。最後一百米未能望空。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Began well from gate 1, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, showed limited response in straight, weakened gradually final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上對催策反應平平，最後一百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W4W) Jumped with them, raced 2 wide in midfield, commenced move 500M, 3 lengths or so back turning in, peaked early in straight, kept on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W4W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間位置，走第二疊。五百米處開始上前。入直路時落後約三個馬位。直路早段未能再增速，保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W3W) Mid-field, forward move to chase leaders 400m out, lacked pace to challenge, no extra final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居中間位置。四百米處上前追趕領先馬匹。速度不足以展開挑戰。最後一百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W1W) Settled midfield on the rail, navigated through traffic in the Straight, ran on okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。直路上在馬群中推進上前。走勢尚可。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W) Held up last, pushed along widest into home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W) 留居包尾位置。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Held up last, still in last place top of home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 留居包尾位置。直路初仍居包尾位置。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (4W3W3W5W) Taken back to race at rear, 6 lengths or so back in the middle stages, a bit closer turning in, made good progress in straight to be nearest on line.
Rider dropped his whip near 300M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(4W3W3W5W) 留居後列。中段落後約六個馬位。入直路時略為追近。直路上追前甚多，過終點時最為接近。
騎師於接近三百米處時跌掉馬鞭。
runnerrecords.incident_chi: 騎師於接近三百米處時跌掉馬鞭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Jumped awkwardly, taken back to race at rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept on evenly in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘笨拙，留居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W2W3W) Waited with in rear, pushed along over 400m out, no headway.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居後列，留力候上。四百米處受推策，未能追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W3W5W) Away with them, raced 3 wide with cover behind midfield, very wide turning in, made no impression in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W3W5W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間之後位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。入直路時走大外疊，直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Waited with towards rear, pushed along wide into home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居後列，留力候上。入直路時受推策，走外疊。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W4W) Towards rear, struggling and left well behind from top of home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W4W) 居後列。自直路初起掙扎上前，落後甚遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W3W2W4W) Held up last, driven along and outpaced middle stages, wide into home straight, never involved.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W3W2W4W) 留居包尾位置。中段受催策及被拋離。入直路時走外疊。從未參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W3W3W3W) Settled worse than midfield, traveled greenly, raced wide and without cover, never a danger.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W3W3W3W) 居中間之後位置，走勢稚嫩。走外疊，沒有遮擋。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Raced in rear, had to wait for run turning into home straight, outpaced and left behind final 250m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居後列。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。最後二百五十米處未能跟上步速，被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Jumped awkwardly and made contact, taken back to race 2 wide at rear, 6 to 7 lengths back turning in, failed to close off in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 出閘笨拙及與對手互相觸碰，留居後列，走第二疊。入直路時落後六至七個馬位。直路上衝刺乏力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Jumped only fairly, raced at rear throughout, never a factor.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘僅屬一般，沿途居包尾位置。從未有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W5W) Steadily away and settled in the second half of the field, was well back turning into straight and made no impression in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W5W) 出閘緩慢，居後半馬群之中。轉入直路時遙居於後。末段毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W) Average to begin, raced 2 wide behind midfield, there to turn, no clear run early in straight, cleared 200M but only showed limited response thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W) 出閘一般，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路初未能望空。二百米處望空，但其後對催策反應僅屬平平。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Sat on pace 3 wide, weakened and gave ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 居前列，走第三疊。末段轉弱及墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Settled behind the leaders, one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 居領先馬匹之後。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W2W2W) Jumped well, sat on pace, minor ground made when asked (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 出閘迅速，跟前競跑。在催策下略為追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W4W) Held up in last few, went wide for a run into straight but baulked until 250M out, kept on well in closing stages without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W4W) 留居最後數位之內。入直路時移出外疊取位，但受困直至二百五十米處。末段保持佳勢，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Began only fairly, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, made some progress early in straight, peaked 150M, kept on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段略為追前，一百五十米處未能再增速。保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W3W) raced 3 wide with cover behind midfield, 5 lengths back turning in, kept on same pace until no clear run final 50M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。入直路時落後五個馬位。其後保持同速，最後五十米未能望空。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, ridden 500m out, switched for clear run top of home straight, stayed on but never going pace to get competitive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。五百米處受催策。直路初轉換跑線以望空。保持走勢，但從未能加速以爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W2W) Slightly slow out and crowded, raced behind midfield on the inside, 2 wide turning in, no clear run until final 150M, made some progress thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W2W) 出閘稍慢及受擠迫，居中間之後位置，走內疊。入直路時走第二疊。未能望空直至一百五十米處，其後略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Settled worse than midfield 3 wide, made minor progress.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Sent forward to lead, faded top of the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 受催策上前領放。直路初力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W2W) Tracked pace, unable to quicken 400m out, no extra final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W2W) 跟隨領放馬。四百米處未能加速。最後二百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W1W) Led, gave ground in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W1W) 領先，其後直路上墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W4W) Three wide in mid-field without cover, under pressure to hold position 700m out, bumped and lost balance 250m out, eased once well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。七百米處在催策下保持位置。二百五十米處與對手互相碰撞，失去平衡。落後甚遠時隨即收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W3W) Tracked pace, three wide throughout, one paced under pressure final 300m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W3W) 跟隨領放馬，沿途走第三疊。最後三百米在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(-) (1W1W) Showed great speed to lead, kicked three lengths clear top of home straight, weakened final 200m, headed by winner 100m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(-)(1W1W) 展現甚快前速，取得領先。直路初加速帶離三個馬位。最後二百米轉弱。一百米處被頭馬超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) Showed great speed to lead, set strong pace, pressed in front, headed 200m out, faded final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 展現甚快前速，取得領先，在快步速領放下受追迫。二百米處被超越。最後二百米力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Jumped awkwardly settling just worse than midfield in 9th, made no impression in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘笨拙，居中間稍後第九位。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W) Pressed leader, bumped and lost balance 300m out, dropped away quickly final 300m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W) 追迫領放馬。三百米處發生碰撞，失去平衡。最後三百米迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) Soon led, pressed by rival in middle stages, quickened to a clear lead early straight, kept on well just only to be caught near line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 瞬即取得領先，中段受一駒追迫。直路早段加速帶離對手，保持佳勢，僅於接近終點時被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (5W2W3W) Tracked leaders, keen middle stages, unable to hold position final bend, eased when detached 200m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(5W2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹，中段搶口。直路彎未能保持位置。二百米處被拋離，收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W) Fast break, made all, kicked three lengths clear 200m out, won unchallenged and going away.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，一直領放。二百米處加速帶離三個馬位。在未受挑戰下拋離對手取勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Jumped with them, raced in midfield on the outside, 2 lengths back turning in, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間位置，走外疊。轉入直路時落後兩個馬位。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (3W4W) Began well, taken back to race behind midfield on the outside, hampered near 700M, 5 lengths back turning in, finished off strongly to score.
(Sustained a wound to the left hind cannon.)
runnerrecords.healthissue_eng: (Sustained a wound to the left hind cannon.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(3W4W) 出閘迅速，留居中間之後位置，走外疊。接近七百米處時受阻礙。入直路時落後五個馬位，末段衝刺強勁，掄元。
（左後腿管骨部位有傷口。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped awkwardly, chased the leader, weakened inside 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘笨拙，追趕領放馬。最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W1W) Settled midfield, raced keenly in the middle stages, responded nicely when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W1W) 居中間位置。中段搶口。對催策反應良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; Crowded shortly after start, positioned 3 lengths behind the leader on the middle track, made no progress final 400M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;起步後不久受擠迫，落後領放馬三個馬位，在跑道中央競跑。最後四百米毫無進展。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Average to begin, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, unable to obtain clear run in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘普通，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上未能望空。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (2W2W) Mid division, unable to secure clear run until 250m out, ran on strongly final 100m, unlucky.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(2W2W) 居中間位置。未能望空直至二百五十米處。最後一百米走勢強勁，但跑來欠運。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Prominent early stages, given reminders to hold pace from 800M out, produced good late impression inside final 150M.
(Lame in left front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 早段居前列。自八百米處起受鞭策以保持步速。最後一百五十米追前甚多。
（左前腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Shifted in at start and bumped, raced 2 wide behind midfield, 4 to 5 lengths back turning in, kept on same pace in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 起步時向內斜跑及被碰撞，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後四至五個馬位。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Shifted in and bumped out of stalls, mid division, twice bumped 400m out to 350m out, stayed on well but no threat to winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘時向內斜跑及被碰撞，居中間位置。四百米處至三百五十米處之間兩度被碰撞。保持佳勢，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Commenced well, sent forward to take the lead, travelled keenly in the early stages, led by 1/2L turning in, peaked and headed 250M, weakened final 150M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放，早段搶口。入直路時領先半個馬位。二百五十米處未能再增速，被超越。最後一百五十米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W4W) Taken back from gate 13, raced towards rear on the outside, there to turn, made some headway in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W4W) 自第十三檔出閘，留居後列，走外疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Began smartly, raced prominently, 2 wide, there to turn, took the lead early in straight, kept on well but unable to hold off the winner late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 出閘迅速，居前列，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路早段取得領先。保持佳勢，但末段不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Tracked leader, unable to quicken 200m out, stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 跟隨領放馬。二百米處未能加速，末段持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W4W4W) Sat 3 wide no cover in front of midfield, weakened in the Straight. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W4W4W) 居中間之前位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。直路上轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W2W) Sat on pace 2 wide, closed off nicely, just lost in a photo.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W2W) 居前列，走第二疊。末段衝刺良佳，在電眼判決下僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W5W) Wide in mid-field, keen mid-race, weakened 300m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W5W) 居中間位置，走外疊。中段搶口。三百米處轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Ridden along in first few, drifted over 2L back in 5th 800M out, slightly worse into straight but recovered some late ground closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 受催策，居前列。八百米處墮居第五位，落後逾兩個馬位。入直路時略為墮後，但末段收復部分失地。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W2W) Ridden forward gradually from a wide barrier to join the leader 800M out, came under pressure again from 500M out but folded up quickly after straightening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W2W) 自外檔出閘，在催策下逐漸上前，八百米處追上領放馬。自五百米處起再度受催策，但入直路後迅速力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced at tail, 6 lengths back, same margin back turning in, made good progress in straight without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 自大外檔出閘，留居包尾位置，落後六個馬位。轉入直路時落後相同距離。直路上追前甚多，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Sat midfield 3 wide, one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。末段在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Ridden 3-wide in midfield early stages, 6th 2-wide rounding home bend, ran on in straight to be nearest at finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 早段居中間位置，走第三疊。轉直路彎時居第六位，走第二疊。直路上追前，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W4W) Gradually settled in midfield and wide without cover, remained in similar position into straight, ran home one-paced.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W4W) 逐漸居中間位置，走外疊，沒有遮擋。入直路時居相若位置。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (3W4W) Raced in touch, keen to halfway, good headway from 300m out, led 100m out, ran on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(3W4W) 跟隨領先馬匹，半程前搶口。自三百米處起追前甚多。一百米處取得領先，末段走勢良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (4W4W) Mid-field, three wide, stayed on steadily final 300m, overhauled runner-up to lead late on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(4W4W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。最後三百米保持穩勢。末段超越亞軍馬匹，取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W3W) Jumped awkwardly, made contact with the right side of its starting gate and lost ground, raced 2 wide, 4 lengths or so back, similar position on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W3W) 出閘笨拙，觸碰閘廂右側，因而失地，落後約四個馬位，走第二疊。直路彎居相若位置。直路初未能再加速，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (1W1W) Shifted out at start, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened final 250M. (See Racing Incidents.)
(Roarer and blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(1W1W) 起步時向外斜跑，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段未能再增速，最後二百五十米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）
（患有喘鳴症及氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W2W) Jumped awkwardly, raced prominently on the outside, took the lead 800M, headed turning in, retook the lead 250M, kept on well but unable to hold off the winner close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W2W) 出閘笨拙，居前列，走外疊。八百米處取得領先。入直路時被超越。二百五十米處重奪領先。保持佳勢，但接近終點時未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W2W) Shared early pace out wide, obtained 2-wide position in joint 2nd rounding home bend, faded steadily under pressure inside final 300M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W2W) 早段並排領先，走外疊。轉直路彎時並居第二位，走第二疊。最後三百米在催策下逐漸力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W) Sat box seat, kept on until weakened final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W) 居包廂位置。保持走勢，直至最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Jumped awkwardly, sat handy, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 出閘笨拙，居前列。衝刺平穩。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W2W) Tracked pace, stayed on for pressure, carried left closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W2W) 跟隨領放馬。在催策下保持走勢。末段被帶向外跑。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat on pace, traveled strongly, had every chance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領放馬。走勢強勁。已獲機會盡展所長。

formguide.comments_eng: New Zealand PPG, a 4-year-old gelding, by War Decree out of Sweet Indulgence, a daughter of Thorn Park. Horses by the same sire include Definitive and Armour War Eagle. He was given three trials for one placing in Hong Kong. In the latest trial, he made the run and finished third under pressure, beaten by 1/2L, over 1200m on turf in Conghua on October 12. He will probably need a run.
formguide.comments_chi: 「戰爭政令」(War Decree)之後，在港同父馬包括「時時精準」及「穿甲戰鷹」等駒，生母出自Thorn Park。抵港後三次試閘一次上名。最近10月12日出試從化草地1200米，早段領放，末段力策下跑第三名，落後頭馬半個馬位。首戰熱身為主。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W1W) Sat in front of midfield on the rail, ran on nicely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W1W) 居中間之前位置，走內欄。走勢良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W) Held up last after slowly away, rail position throughout, unable to get on terms with leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W) 出閘緩慢，留居包尾位置。沿途走內欄。未能追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W) Sat behind midfield 2 wide, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Moderately away, raced 2 wide towards rear, hampered near 700M, 6 lengths back turning in, made some progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘普通，居後列，走第二疊。接近七百米處時受阻礙。入直路時落後六個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) 3-wide in midfield early stages, taken back towards rear in 8th into back straight, hung in and unbalanced causing interferences 500M out, kept on same pace from 7th into straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 早段居中間位置，走第三疊。入對面直路時留居後列第八位。五百米處內閃及失去平衡，造成干擾。入直路時居第七位，保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (1W1W) Average to begin, positioned 2 lengths behind the leader on the inside, saved ground on turn, no clear run until approaching final 100M, finished off strongly to score by a neck.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(1W1W) 出閘普通，落後領放馬兩個馬位，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。未能望空直至趨近一百米處。衝刺強勁，以一馬頸位之先勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W1W) Sent forward from wide draw, across to lead outright after 500m, headed over 200m out, weakened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W1W) 自大外檔出閘，受催策上前。跑了五百米後切入單騎領放。二百米處被超越，轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W) Soon taken back to last few and waited with, shifted wide for a run onto home bend, made up good ground inside final 200M to be nearest at finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W) 瞬即留居最後數位之內，留力候上。開始轉直路彎時移出外疊取位。最後二百米追前甚多，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Settled worse than midfield on the rail, made no ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。末段未能追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Began awkwardly and made contact, taken back to race at tail, 5 to 6 lengths back turning in, passed some tired runners in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 出閘笨拙，與對手互相觸碰，留居包尾位置。入直路時落後五至六個馬位。直路上超越數匹已呈疲態的對手。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W) Waited with in rear, driven along and some headway early in home straight, no extra final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W) 居後列，留力候上。直路早段受催策，略為追前。最後一百五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Bumped at the start, from draw 10 dropped back to near last, had some work to do 400M, finished off nicely to take 5th. Nearest line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 自第十檔起步時發生碰撞，墮居接近包尾位置。四百米處稍為落後。衝刺良佳，取得第五名。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (1W3W) Sat midfield, traveled only fairly, gave ground quickly in the Straight (Must BT).
(Irregular heart rhythm.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(1W3W) 居中間位置，走勢僅屬一般。直路上迅速墮退。（必須試閘及格。）
（心律不正常。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W1W) Out with rest, raced behind midfield on inner, saved ground on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened final furlong.
(Roarer again.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
極慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間之後位置，走內欄。直路彎走內欄節省腳程。直路初未能再增速。最後二百米轉弱。
（再次患有喘鳴症。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (2W2W) Commenced well, positioned 2 wide better than midfield, there to turn, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
Roarer.
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路早段未能再加速，其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）
患有喘鳴症。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (4W5W) Hampered start, raced towards rear on the outside, ridden from 450M but showed no response, eased final 200M. (See Racing Incidents.)
Roarer.
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(4W5W) 起步時受阻礙，居後列，走外疊。自四百五十米處起受催策，但毫無反應。最後二百米收慢。（見競賽事件報告。）
患有喘鳴症。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Shown good early speed to lead, kept on strongly, always doing enough.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 展現甚快前速領放。末段保持勁勢，足以取勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (2W1W1W) Began well, raced in 3rd, a length or so back, saved ground on turn, showed some response early in straight, peaked on run 100M, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
(Roarer again.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(2W1W1W) 出閘迅速，居第三位，落後約一個馬位。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初對催策略有反應。一百米處未能再增速，其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）
（再次患有喘鳴症。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (2W4W) Settled in mid-field, under pressure 600m out, lacked pace to challenge, eased when detached 150m out.
(Roarer again.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(2W4W) 居中間位置。六百米處受催策，速度不足以展開挑戰。一百五十米處被拋離之際收慢。
（再次患有喘鳴症。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, well placed into home straight, strong run to lead close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。入直路時居好位。衝刺強勁，接近終點時取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Began well, raced better than midfield on the inside, 2 wide on turn, finished off well, just missed out on 2nd in a photo.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走第二疊。衝刺良佳，在電眼判決下僅失亞席。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Sat in front of midfield 2 wide, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W3W) Travelled in midfield despite ridden along in first 200M, about 4L back in 6th rounding home bend, tight inside runners and baulked for a run early in straight, made no impression inside final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W3W) 儘管首二百米受催策，居中間位置。轉直路彎時居第六位，落後約四個馬位。直路初在對手內側緊迫競跑及受困。最後二百米毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Away well, raced 2 wide in midfield, 3 wide after passing 600M, showed limited response early in straight, weakened final furlong. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 出閘迅速，居中間位置，走第二疊。跑過六百米處後走第三疊。直路初對催策反應平平。最後二百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W4W) Sat in front of midfield 2 wide, closed off okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W4W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。末段衝刺尚可。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Rear of mid-field, had to wait for run early in home straight, angled wider 200m out, stayed on, unable to reach leaders.
(Blood in mouth.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 居中間之後位置。直路早段須等待空位出現。二百米處移出較外疊。保持走勢，但未能追上領先馬匹。
（口內有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Shifted out at start, raced behind midfield, 2 wide, hampered near 900M, 5 lengths back on turn, no clear run early in straight, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 起步時向外斜跑，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。接近九百米處時受阻礙。直路彎落後五個馬位。直路早段未能望空。保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W) Box seat, switched inside to challenge leaders top of home straight, unable to pick up for pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W) 居包廂位置。直路初向內移入以挑戰領先馬匹。末段受催策，但未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W2W2W) Pressed leader, quickened early to lead turning into home straight, headed by winner and weakened close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W2W2W) 追迫領放馬。轉入直路時率先加速，取得領先。接近終點時被頭馬超越，轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W) Tracked leader, under pressure to challenge leader 400m out, stayed on well but no match for winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W) 跟隨領放馬。四百米處在催策下挑戰領放馬。末段保持佳勢，但不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W2W) Began well from gate 1, took the early lead, headed 950M, 2nd in the middle stages, hard ridden from 200M, retook the lead 150M, kept on well but unable to hold off the winner late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W2W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，早段取得領先。九百五十米處被超越，中段居第二位。自二百米處起受力策，一百五十米處再次取得領先。保持佳勢，但末段不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (6W1W1W) Involved in early battle for lead, led outright after 450m, responded to pressure from 300m out, challenged 100m out, winner too strong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(6W1W1W) 早段爭奪領先，跑了四百五十米後單騎領放。自三百米處起對催策交出反應。一百米處受挑戰。未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (5W2W2W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced at tail, 6 lengths or so back turning in, passed some tired runners in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(5W2W2W) 自外檔出閘，留居包尾位置。轉入直路時落後約六個馬位。直路上超越數匹已呈疲態的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W3W) Jumped moderately from the wideset barrier and soon taken well back, commenced move inside the 600M racing 3-wide rounding home bend, obtained a clear run just inside the 200M, ran on well without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W3W) 自最外檔出閘普通，瞬即留居遙遙落後的位置。六百米處開始上前，轉直路彎時走第三疊。跑過二百米處後望空。以佳勢追前，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, ridden top of home straight, outpaced and left behind final 250m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。直路初受催策。最後二百五十米未能跟上步速，被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Settled in mid-field, crowded middle stages, under pressure 500m out, well held from 300m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置。中段受擠迫。五百米處受催策。自三百米處起遙遙落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Began well, raced prominently behind leader, failed to run on passing 300M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居領放馬之後的前列位置。跑過三百米處時未能追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W2W) Crowded on jumping, raced 3 wide in midfield early, 2 wide from 750M, 4 lengths or so back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W2W) 躍出時受擠迫。早段居中間位置，走第三疊。自七百五十米處起走第二疊。入直路時落後約四個馬位。直路初未能再增速。最後一百五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W3W) Away awkwardly and lost ground, settled back in the field, last turning home, failed to run on under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W3W) 出閘笨拙及失地，居後列。轉直路彎時居包尾位置。其後在催策下未能追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W3W) Away with them, raced in midfield on the outside, 4 lengths back turning in, made some progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W3W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間位置，走外疊。入直路時落後四個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W1W) Moderately away, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, angled out early in straight, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘普通，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初向外移出，衝刺平穩。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Stumbled leaving stalls, mid division, under pressure 550m out, dropped away quickly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 出閘時失蹄，居中間位置。五百五十米處受催策。最後二百米迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Tracked leaders, ridden top of home straight, one paced under pressure, just missed third.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。直路初受催策。在催策下保持同速。僅失去季席。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Bumped shortly after start, chased leader, strong run to lead 300m out, kicked 3 lengths clear 200m out, won going away.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 起步後不久被碰撞，追趕領放馬。走勢強勁，三百米處取得領先。二百米處加速帶離三個馬位。拋離對手勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Jumped on terms from draw 1, reserved in midfield on settling, held up for clear running from 400m to 200M before finishing off well. Not ridden out close home when racing tight. Could have finished 3rd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 自第一檔與對手同步躍出，留居中間位置。四百米處至二百米處之間受困而未能望空。其後衝刺良佳。接近終點緊迫競跑時未能被力策。本應有望跑入季席。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Away in line, settled down midfield 4Ls off the pace, into clear running 350M, stayed on fairly well to go 3rd near line. Not reach first two.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間位置，落後領放馬四個馬位。三百五十米處望空。保持不俗走勢，接近終點時進佔第三位，但未能追上頭兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Disputed led, challenged by rivals top of home straight, headed 250m out, faded final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 爭奪領先。直路初受對手挑戰。二百五十米處被超越。最後一百米力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W) Settled in 4th always in touch with leaders, travelled best of all at 400M, quickened to grab narrow lead inside 200M, stuck to task well late and was always holding off the persistent 2nd under confident riding.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W) 居第四位，一直跟隨領先馬匹。四百米處走勢最佳。加速上前，二百米處以短距離領先。末段持續以佳勢力拼，在力策下力拒持續挑戰的亞軍馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Raced in clear third a few lengths behind leading pair, stuck to task under pressure final 250m but one paced, unable to threaten.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 居領先兩駒之後頗遠的第三位，落後數個馬位。最後二百五十米在催策下持續力拼，但保持同速。未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, pressed in front, kicked 300m out, headed by winner 100m out, sticking to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 展現甚快前速以領放。在領放下受追迫。三百米處加速。一百米處被頭馬超越，但持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Showed great speed to lead, quickened early in home straight and soon in command, won comfortably.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 展現甚佳前速以領放。直路早段加速，瞬即控制大局，從容獲勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Began well from gate 1, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1-1/2L turning in, kept on well early in straight, peaked and headed 100M, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，受催策上前，取得領先。入直路時領先一個半馬位。直路初保持佳勢。一百米處未能再加速，被超越，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (2W2W) Stayed close to leaders, raced keenly in the middle stages when pace was steadied, briefly held up for clear running 400M but couldn't go on afterwards.
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(2W2W) 保持緊隨領先馬匹。中段在步速減慢時搶口。四百米處一度受困而未能望空，但其後無以為繼。
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W) Jumped well from draw 1 and sat in 3rd, had difficulty obtaining clear running passing for some distance passing 250M but the finishing response was only when fair late stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居第三位。跑過二百五十米處時在一段途程上難以望空，但末段衝刺僅屬一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W3W) From draw 1 stayed close enough to leaders, was repeatedly denied for clear running in the home straight before easing off final 150M when no chance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W3W) 自第一檔出閘，保持緊隨領先馬匹。直路上一再未能望空。最後一百五十米在再無爭逐機會下收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Soon disputed lead, led outright after 450m, raced clear with one other, saw off that rival and over 3 lengths clear 200m out, closed down from there and headed late on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 瞬即爭奪領先。過了四百五十米處後單騎領放。與另一駒一同帶離餘駒。二百米處拋離該駒，領先逾三個馬位。自該處起被追上，於末段被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Soon took up running setting a steady pace, pulled 3L clear from home bend drawing further away in the straight for an impressive victory.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 瞬即帶頭，以平穩步速領放。自直路彎起帶離三個馬位。直路上進一步帶離，以漂亮姿態勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sent forward to lead, ran on strongly, won going away, impressive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 受催策上前領放。走勢強勁，帶離勝出。表現出色。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Shifted in shortly after start and made contact, sent forward to take the lead, hard ridden from 300M, peaked and headed 150M, kept on evenly to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;起步後不久向內斜跑，與他駒互相觸碰，受催策上前領放。自三百米處起受力策。一百五十米處未能再增速及被超越。保持穩勢，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(-) Prominent, improved to lead against far rail 600m out, driven 400m out, headed by winner 200m out, no match for winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(-)居前列。沿外欄推進上前，六百米處取得領先。四百米處受催策。二百米處被頭馬超越，未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Made running against stand rail, kicked 1.5L clear 300m out, headed 100m out, no extra.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;沿外欄帶頭。三百米處加速帶離一個半馬位。一百米處被超越，再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W3W) Bumped start, raced 2 wide better than midfield, difficult to settle in the early and middle stages, peaked approaching 300M, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W3W) 起步時與對手互相碰撞，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。早段及中段難以穩定走勢。趨近三百米處時未能再加速，其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W) Waited with towards rear, short of room early in home striaght, switched for clear run 150m out, stayed on for pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W) 居後列，留力候上。直路初空位不足。一百五十米處轉換跑線以望空。末段在催策下保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W2W) Waited with in rear, raced keenly throughout, had to wait for run turning into home straight, clear run 200m out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W2W) 居後列，留力候上。沿途搶口。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。二百米處望空，但速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Not far off the leaders early stages, checked 750M losing ground, had 3-4Ls to make up 400M, lacked a finishing kick and was safely held in the end.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;早段落後領先馬匹不遠。七百五十米處勒避，失地。四百米處落後三至四個馬位。末段衝刺乏力，未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Settled in worse than midfield and waited with, obtained a run just over 200M out and quickened well to snatch victory final strides.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;居中間之後位置，留力候上。就在過了二百米處後取得空位上前。以佳勢加速，最後數步取得勝利。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; From draw 1 raced behind midfield towards the outside of the group, ran on one paced final 400M posing little threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;自第一檔出閘後居中間之後位置，靠近馬群外側競跑。最後四百米保持同速，對領先馬匹威脅不大。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Settled in rear of mid-field, pushed along towards centre of course 400m out, bumped 300m out, strong run to lead 100m out, on top from there.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;居中間之後位置。四百米處受推策，在跑道中央競跑。三百米處發生碰撞。走勢強勁，一百米處取得領先，其後保持領先，勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Shifted in and bumped leaving stalls, rear of mid-field, briefly hampered 100m out, struggling.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 出閘時向內斜跑，發生碰撞，居中間之後位置。一百米處一度受阻礙，掙扎上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Mid-field, effort top of home straight, outpaced final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置。直路初受催策。最後二百米被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Pressed leader, disputed led from 700m out, quickened early to lead top of home straight but soon headed, gave ground final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 追迫領放馬，自七百米處起爭奪領先。直路初加速，取得領先，但瞬即被超越。最後二百米墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Ridden early gradually settling some 2L back in 4th over 600M out, commenced move home bend and ran on under pressure for slender advantage inside the 150M, just held on to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 早段受催策，六百米處逐漸居第四位，落後約兩個馬位。直路彎開始發力，受催策上前，一百五十米處以短距離領先，僅勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W2W2W) Pressed leader, keen early, disputed led final bend, dropped away quickly in home straight, eased once well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W2W2W) 追迫領放馬，早段搶口。直路彎爭奪領先。直路上迅速墮退。遙遙落後時隨即收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W1W1W) From draw 10 sent forward vying for early lead, emerged as clear leader going into home turn, kept going well in the straight, headed nearing 150M before fading to finish 5th.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W1W1W) 自第十檔出閘，早段受催策上前爭奪領先。進入直路彎時領放。直路上保持佳勢，接近一百五十米處時被超越，其後力竭，取得第五名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Ridden to be up with the pace settling one-out-one-back 650M out, fought on steadily from a similar position into straight but never threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 受催策以跟上步速。六百五十米處居第二疊第二位。入直路時居相若位置，持續力拼，但從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W1W1W) Jumped well and led, kicked clear from the 500M, kept on to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W1W1W) 出閘迅速，取得領先。自五百米處起加速帶離對手，保持走勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W2W1W2W) Waited with towards rear, forced to steady 400m out, outpaced and left behind in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W2W1W2W) 居後列，留力候上。四百米處被迫收慢，直路上未能跟上步速，被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Three wide in rear of mid-field without cover, driven along 450m out, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。四百五十米處受催策。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Settled in rear of mid-field, had to wait for run turning into home straight, tight for room against rail early in home straight, made up some late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居中間之後位置。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。直路初沿欄受緊迫。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Reserved behind midfield along the inside, in similar spot 3Ls off the pace home turn before running on strongly final 300M to take lead close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 留居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎居相若位置，落後領放馬三個馬位。最後三百米以勁勢衝刺，接近終點時取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Dropped back on jumping from a wide draw, raced as the back marker 7Ls off the pace, failed to respond turning home and soon eased. (No Vet findings / Unacceptable Performance.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 自大外檔躍出後墮後，居包尾位置，落後領放馬七個馬位。轉入直路時對催策毫無反應，瞬即收慢。（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。表現難以接受。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; Sat midfield, checked at 150M, never involved afterwards.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;居中間位置。一百五十米處勒避，其後從未參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast; (2W2W) Settled in mid-field, short-lived effort 300m out, no extra final 200m.
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置。三百米處一度發力。最後二百米再無餘力。
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Shifted out at start, raced better than midfield on the outside in the early stages, took the lead approaching 800M, led by 1-1/4L turning in, kept on very strongly in straight, won by 2-1/2L.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 起步時向外斜跑。早段居中間之前位置，走外疊。趨近八百米處時取得領先。入直路時領先一又四分一個馬位。直路上保持勁勢，以兩個半馬位之先掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Box seat, under pressure to hold position from 600m out, weakened quickly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居包廂位置。自六百米處起受催策以保持位置。最後二百米迅速轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(-) (1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, ridden top of home straight, headed by winner 300m out, sticking to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(-)(1W1W) 展現甚快前速領放。直路初受催策。三百米處被頭馬超越，持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W2W) Up with early pace then eased to a trailing position behind leaders, fought on one paced early straight before overrun by rivals closing stages. (Jockey - instructed to go forward as it did in a barrier trial.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W2W) 早段跟上步速，其後收慢，居領先馬匹之後有遮擋的位置。直路早段保持同速，末段被對手超越。（騎師表示，他獲指示讓坐騎如試閘時般上前。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Made contact shortly after start, raced behind midfield on the outside, very wide turning in, failed to close off in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 起步後不久發生觸碰，居中間之後位置，走外疊。入直路時走大外疊。直路上衝刺乏力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W3W) Raced in touch with leaders, some headway on bend, hung out 400m out, gave ground final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W3W) 緊隨領先馬匹。直路彎略為追前。四百米處外閃。最後一百五十米墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W3W) Bumped start and unbalanced, raced 2 wide better than midfield, 5 lengths or so back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W3W) 出閘時被碰撞，失去平衡，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後約五個馬位。直路早段未能再增速，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (3W1W1W) Bumped leaving stalls, across from widest draw to lead, headed top of home straight, gave ground final 200m.
(Lame in right front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(3W1W1W) 自最外檔出閘時被碰撞，切入內疊領放。直路初被超越。最後二百米墮退。
（右前腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Made contact at start, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept on well early in straight, peaked on run 100M, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 起步時與對手互相觸碰，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初保持佳勢。一百米處未能再增速。末段走勢平穩。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Jumped awkwardly, ridden along to lead, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 出閘笨拙，在催策下領放。末段走勢平穩。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Slowly away, some headway early in home straight, left behind final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘緩慢。直路早段略為追前。最後二百米被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Made contact at start, positioned 2 to 3 lengths behind the leader, 2 away from the stands' rail, hard ridden from 400M but only showed limited response, kept on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;起步時發生觸碰。落後領放馬兩至三個馬位，走外欄第三疊。自四百米處起受力策，但反應僅屬平平。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Prominent in 3rd from a wide barrier, one-off the rail rounding home bend, weakened under pressure inside final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 自外檔出閘，居前列第三位。轉直路彎時走第二疊。最後二百米在催策下轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Pressed forward from the widest barrier to soon take up running on the rail, led until joined 600M out, unable to sustain effort and swamped 150M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自大外檔出閘，受催策上前，瞬即取得領先，走內欄。領放，直至六百米處被追上。其後未能保持走勢，一百五十米處被後上馬匹超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, driven along 450m out, flattened out final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。四百五十米處受催策。最後二百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Led early, ceded advantage for one-back 2nd after the first 200M, re-gained lead in home straight 300M out kicking over 2L clear over 150M out, hung on well to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 早段領先，過了首二百米後被超越，居第二位，落後一個馬位。直路上三百米處重奪領先位置。一百五十米處加速帶離逾兩個馬位。保持佳勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Soon took up running setting a fast pace in middle stages, led the field until headed 250M out and swamped for a placing inside final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 瞬即取得領先，中段以快步速領放。帶頭競跑，直至二百五十米處被超越。最後一百米被後上馬匹過頭，失去三甲位置。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Sat outside lead, traveled strongly, kept on well to win.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居領放馬外側，走勢強勁。保持佳勢，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Settled towards rear on rail, shifted out away from fading runners over 600M out, one-paced in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居後列，走內欄。六百米處向外移出避開力竭的對手。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W1W) Chased leader in joint 2nd or 3rd on rail, came under pressure to hold place rounding home bend, dropped out of contention shortly after straightening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 追趕領放馬，並列第二或第三位，走內欄。轉直路彎時在催策下保持位置。入直路後不久墮退，再無爭逐機會。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Settled in the back half of the field 6Ls off leader, couldn't go on passing 300M, dropped out rapidly well beaten.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 居後半馬群中，落後領放馬六個馬位。跑過三百米處時未能上前。迅速墮退，所負甚遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Slightly slow out, raced 2 wide slightly better than midfield, found rail near 900M, saved ground on turn, showed no response early in straight, weakened 300M, finished tailed out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 出閘稍慢，居中間稍前位置，走第二疊。接近九百米處時移入內欄。直路彎走內欄節省腳程。直路初對催策毫無反應。三百米處轉弱。包尾大敗而回。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Crowded and bumped at start, settled in mid-field, short of room 300m out, stayed on but lacked pace to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 起步時受擠迫及發生碰撞，居中間位置。三百米處空位不足。保持走勢，但速度不足以追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Began well, raced towards rear on the outside, 5 lengths back turning in, made no progress in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 出閘迅速，居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後五個馬位。直路上毫無進展。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Broke well from the one draw settling in forward of midfield mainly in 5th just under 6L off the pace, gained closer to just over 2L off the lead 200M out, soon found no extra.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，大多居第五位，落後領放馬近六個馬位。其後追近，二百米處落後領放馬稍逾兩個馬位。瞬即再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (1W2W) Last to jump, sat midfield on the rail, slightly held up early part of the Straight, ran on strongly, always held.
(Jockey dropped right rein between the 200 Metres and the 100 Metres.)
runnerrecords.incident_eng: (Jockey dropped right rein between the 200 Metres and the 100 Metres.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘最慢，居中間位置，走內欄。直路初略為受困。以勁勢上前，但一直落後頭馬。
（騎師於二百米處至一百米處之間右邊韁繩脫手。）
runnerrecords.incident_chi: （騎師於二百米處至一百米處之間右邊韁繩脫手。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Jumped awkwardly and lost ground, held up in midfield along the inside, came with a serious challenge passing 300M but was crowded 100M losing momentum. Could have finished closer.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 出閘笨拙及失地，留居中間位置，走內疊。跑過三百米處時展開真正挑戰，但一百米處受擠迫，失去步韻。本可跑入更前位置。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W4W) Settled towards rear, commenced move 3-wide rounding home bend, tightened and forced to switch inside 400M out, inconvenienced again just inside the 200M, finished off the race well.
