runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W4W) 居後列。轉直路彎時開始上前，走第三疊。四百米處受緊迫，被迫移向內疊。跑過二百米處後再度受妨礙。末段以佳勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Began only fairly, raced slightly behind midfield on the outside, moved a bit closer after passing 900M, made contact 700M, 1 to 2 lengths back turning in, closed off well to take 2nd without threatening the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間稍後位置，走外疊。跑過九百米處後略為追近。七百米處發生觸碰。入直路時落後一至兩個馬位。末段衝刺良佳，跑獲亞軍，未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W1W1W) Sat behind midfield, traveled okay, minor progress made when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W1W1W) 居中間之後位置。走勢不俗。在催策下略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Moderately away, raced towards rear, 6 to 7 lengths back turning in, made no impression in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 出閘普通，居後列。入直路時落後六至七個馬位。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Settled in mid-field, forced to steady 800m out, ridden top of home straight, faded final 250m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置。八百米處被迫收慢。直路初受催策。最後二百五十米力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W4W) Up with early pace then eased back to a position ahead of midfield and raced 3-wide without cover for majority of the race, soon no extra leaving the turn and finished tailed out. (Unacceptable Performance.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W4W) 早段跟上步速，其後收慢留後，居中間之前位置。大部分途程走第三疊，沒有遮擋。跑離直路彎時瞬即再無餘力，包尾大敗而回。（表現難以接受。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Held up last, still in last place top of home straight, unable to secure clear run 250m out, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 留居包尾位置。直路初仍居包尾位置。二百五十米處未能望空。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Began well from gate 1, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, made some progress early in straight, peaked 200M, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初略為追前。二百米處未能再增速，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (3W4W) Settled towards the rear 3 wide, made no impression.
(Respiratory condition.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(3W4W) 居後列，走第三疊。毫無表現。
（異常呼吸狀況。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Sat towards rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, made steady progress under whip.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居後列。走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。在鞭策下穩步上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W) Waited with towards rear, still in rear top of home straight, unable to secure clear run until 200m out, ran on well final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W) 居後列，留力候上。直路初仍居後列。未能望空直至二百米處。最後二百米以佳勢追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Waited with in rear, blocked off when going for run 350m out, clear run 300m out, unable to quicken.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居後列，留力候上。三百五十米處取位時受困。三百米處望空，未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Bumped start, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, angled out after passing 400M, finished off well to take 2nd without threatening the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 起步時發生碰撞，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。跑過四百米處後向外移出。末段衝刺良佳，跑獲亞軍，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (1W1W) Began well from gate 1, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, no clear run early in straight, found daylight near 200M, finished off strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段未能望空。接近二百米處時望空，末段衝刺強勁，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W) Shifted in at start and made contact, raced towards rear on the outside, similar position on turn, made some progress early in straight, peaked 150M, kept on evenly to the line. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W) 起步時向內斜跑，發生觸碰，居後列，走外疊。直路彎居相若位置。直路初略為追前，一百五十米處未能再增速，保持穩勢至終點。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Commenced well, raced 2 wide in midfield, 3 to 4 lengths back, there to turn, made some progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居中間位置，落後三至四個馬位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W2W2W) Settled in front of midfield, traveled smoothly, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W2W2W) 居中間之前位置。走勢暢順。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W2W) Taken back from gate 13, raced at rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, made some headway in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W2W) 自第十三檔出閘後留居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上略為追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Jumped well from a wide draw, sent forward to race prominently, found rail near 1150M, shared lead on turn, kept on well early in straight, peaked and headed 100M, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 自外檔出閘迅速，受催策上前，居前列。接近一千一百五十米處時移入內欄。直路彎並排領先。直路早段保持佳勢。一百米處未能再增速及被超越，保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W2W) Broke well from the one draw gradually settled just over 3L off the pace, came under pressure to challenge rounding home bend sharing 3rd briefly into straight, unable to make any further impression in the run to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W2W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，逐漸落後領放馬稍逾三個馬位。轉直路彎時在催策下展開挑戰。入直路時一度並列第三位。末段再無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (4W3W2W4W) Obtained a handy position just ahead of midfield, close enough to the leaders home turn before driven out to take the lead near 200M, held on well from 2nd and 3rd late stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(4W3W2W4W) 居中間稍前的好位。直路彎落後領先馬匹不遠。其後受力策，接近二百米處時取得領先。末段保持佳勢，力拒亞軍及季軍馬匹獲勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W1W1W) Soon took up running taking advantage of the one draw, set steady pace until joined 700M out, re-gained 1L break on straightening only to be denied 100M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 把握自第一檔出閘的優勢，瞬即取得領先。以平穩步速領放，七百米處被追上。入直路時重奪領先位置，帶離一個馬位。僅於最後一百米被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W3W3W4W) From wide draw slotted into a 3-wide spot in midfield, 4-5Ls to make up 400M, ran on steadily to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W3W3W4W) 自大外檔出閘，居中間位置，移入第三疊。四百米處落後四至五個馬位。末段以穩勢上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Began well, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept on well early in straight, peaked on run 100M, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初保持佳勢。一百米處未能再增速。其後逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Raced in touch with leaders, well placed into home straight, ran on strongly to lead 100m out, on top from there.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。入直路時居好位。走勢強勁，一百米處取得領先，其後保持領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Began well from gate 1, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, no clear run until final 100M, made no progress thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。未能望空直至一百米處，其後毫無進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W3W) Jumped only fairly, settled in mid-division 4Ls behind leader, brought widest into straight before running on at the same pace. No threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W3W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間位置，落後領放馬四個馬位。入直路時移出最外疊，其後保持同速。未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Bumped leaving stalls, chased leader, ridden 400m out to challenge leader, no threat to winner, just held third.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 出閘時發生碰撞，追趕領放馬。四百米處受催策以挑戰領放馬。末段未能威脅頭馬，僅保住季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W) Slow to begin, adopted a rearward position 6-7Ls back on settling, lay in under pressure in the home straight, kept on mildly to the line but couldn't be ridden out final 50M when awkwardly placed behind a rival.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W) 出閘緩慢，居後列，落後六至七個馬位。直路上在催策下內閃。末段保持普通走勢，但最後五十米在對手之後處於窘境之際未能被力策。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W) Bumped on jumping, failed to show sufficient pace going forward and ended up behind midfield, failed to gain ground on leaders final 300M. (Jockey - travelled only fairly during the event.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W) 躍出時發生碰撞，未能展現足夠前速上前，其後居中間之後位置。最後三百米未能追近領先馬匹。（騎師表示，坐騎於陣上的走勢僅屬一般。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W1W2W) Raced in rear after checked 1500m out, unable to secure clear run until 200m out, tight for room 150m out, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W1W2W) 千五米處勒避，其後居後列。二百米處前未能望空。一百五十米處受緊迫。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Outpaced early stages and soon detached from the field, dropped out of contention alarmingly from midway. (No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;早段未能跟上步速，瞬即被馬群拋離。自中段起急劇墮退，再無爭勝機會。（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W4W) Three wide in mid-field without cover, taken wider 900m out, shifted right in home straight, lost touch final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W4W) 居中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。九百米處被帶出更外疊。直路上向內斜跑。最後二百米被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (4W3W2W3W) Went forward under 10lb claimer and held the lead first turn, settled in 2nd from 1100M, fought hard to stay in contention early straight before weakening 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(4W3W2W3W) 在獲讓十磅的見習騎師策騎下上前，首個彎位取得領先。自千一米處起居第二位。直路初力拼以保持爭逐機會。二百米處轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W2W3W) Settled in mid-field, ridden early in home straight, stayed on but never going pace to get competitive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W2W3W) 居中間位置。直路初受催策。保持走勢，但從未能加速以爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W3W3W5W) Settled behind midfield 3-wide, pace very slow in the first half of the race, couldn't improve position when driven along home turn, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W3W3W5W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。賽事前半段步速非常緩慢，直路彎受催策時未能追前。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (3W3W4W5W) Bumped start, raced towards rear on the outside, 8 lengths or so back turning in, made very good progress in straight to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(3W3W4W5W) 起步時發生碰撞，居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後約八個馬位。直路上追前甚多，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Tracked leaders, pushed along against rail to chase leaders 500m out, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹。五百米處受推策，沿欄追趕領先馬匹。末段在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (1W1W1W1W) Jumped only fairly, in midfield along the fence early stages, moved within striking distance home turn, loomed behind leaders mid-straight before proving too strong near line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(1W1W1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，早段居中間位置，走內欄。直路彎落後領放馬不遠。直路中段追至領先馬匹之後位置，接近終點時以勁勢超越對手，勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W3W) Moderately away, raced in midfield on the outside, 3 lengths or so back turning in, made some progress early in straight, peaked 200M, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 出閘普通，居中間位置，走外疊。入直路時落後約三個馬位。直路初略為追前。二百米處未能再增速。末段走勢平穩。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Reserved behind midfield along the inside, chased steadily from 400M without threatening first two but wasn't far off 3rd and 4th. Encouraging debut.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 留居中間之後位置，走內疊。自四百米處起以穩勢追前，未能威脅首兩名馬匹，但落後季軍及第四名馬匹不遠。初出表現令人鼓舞。

formguide.comments_eng: Irish PP, a 3-year-old gelding, by Supremacy from Beat Of My Heart, a daughter of Kendargent. He will be the first runner of his sire in Hong Kong. This fellow had two starts for one win (a 3yo maiden over 1600m on Polytrack) and one placing. He was given four trials in Hong Kong. In the latest trial, he sat not far behind the pace and finished fourth under pressure, beaten by 6-1/2Ls, over 1200m AWT in Conghua on October 8. He’s probably not shaping like a first-up winner and this run will undoubtedly improve him.
formguide.comments_chi: 「最尊最上」(Supremacy)之後，是此父系首匹在港上陣馬，生母出自Kendargent。來港前在愛爾蘭兩戰得一勝一位，頭馬為一場膠沙地1600米三歲從未勝出馬賽。抵港後試閘四次。最近10月8日出試從化泥地1200米，早段落後領先馬匹不遠，末段力策下跑第四名，落後頭馬6.5個馬位。應不足以一出即勝，仍需熱身去提升表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W2W) Rail position in mid-field, switched 600m out but short of room early in home straight, switched in 300m out, strong run against rail to edge ahead final 50m in tight finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W2W) 居中間位置，走內欄。六百米處轉換跑線，但直路早段空位不足。三百米處向內移入。沿內欄衝刺強勁，最後五十米取得領先，險勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W2W3W) Settled in front of midfield 2 wide, one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W2W3W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W1W1W) Shifted out at start, held up last, ridden along 600m out, made up some late ground but never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W1W1W) 起步時向外斜跑，留居包尾位置。六百米處受催策。末段略為追前，但從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W2W2W) Tracked pace out wide without cover, improved to chase leader 1000m out, challenged leader top of home straight, flattened out final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W2W2W) 跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。一千米處推進上前，追趕領放馬。直路初挑戰領放馬。最後二百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W2W) Average to begin, raced 2 wide behind midfield, there to turn, finished off evenly. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W2W) 出閘一般，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。末段以穩勢衝刺。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W2W2W3W) Sat worse than midfield, raced keenly in the early stages, stayed on to grab 3rd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W2W2W3W) 居中間之後位置。早段搶口。保持走勢，跑入季席。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W1W2W3W) Reserved in a second half of the field 5-6Ls off the pace, held up on the home turn when the race got serious, into clear running 350M and finished off well to get up in closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W1W2W3W) 留居後半馬群中，落後領放馬五至六個馬位。賽事進入關鍵階段時在直路彎受困。三百五十米處望空。衝刺良佳，末段取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W1W) Made all, strongly challenged by rivals 400m out, joined 200m out, stayed on strongly to hold on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 領放。四百米處受對手強勁挑戰。二百米處被追上。末段保持勁勢，保住勝果。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Held up 3-wide with cover in midfield, in similar position into home straight, one-paced without quickening in the run to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 留居中間位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。入直路時居相若位置。末段保持同速，未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W2W) Chased the lead, traveled nicely, had every chance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W2W) 追趕領放馬，走勢良佳。已獲機會盡展所長。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W3W2W2W) Pressed leaders on outside, one of three that raced clear to halfway, reined back into third, starting to come under pressure when severely checked 350m out, soon lost ground and eased.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W3W2W2W) 追迫領先馬匹，走外疊。為半程前拋離馬群的三駒之一。收慢留居第三位，其後在催策下開始發力上前，三百五十米處大力勒避。瞬即失地及收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W2W2W2W) Sat outside the lead, kept on well for 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W2W2W2W) 居領放馬外側。末段保持佳勢，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W1W) Led or disputed lead throughout, pressed on turning into home straight, headed 100m out, no extra closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W1W) 沿途領先或爭奪領先。轉入直路時受催策。一百米處被超越。末段再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W2W) Pressed leader, under pressure to hold position 500m out, flattened out final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W2W) 追迫領放馬。五百米處在催策下保持位置。最後二百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast(+) (3W1W1W2W) Waited with towards rear, good headway middle stages against rail, travelled smoothy into home straight, ran on well to lead 200m out, just failed.
Blood in mouth.
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速(+)(3W1W1W2W) 居後列，留力候上。中段沿欄追前頗多。入直路時走勢暢順。以佳勢上前，二百米處取得領先，僅敗。
口內有血。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W2W3W) Raced in rear, pushed along wide into home straight, forced to steady top of home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W2W3W) 居後列。入直路時受推策，走外疊。直路初被迫收慢。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W1W1W1W) Crossed to the fence after the jump before settling down towards the rear, had some work to do turning home, closed off best to take 5th
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W1W1W1W) 躍出後切入內欄，其後居後列。轉直路彎時落後頗遠。末段衝刺最快，取得第五名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W2W) Settled in 2nd half of the field 5-6Ls off leader, responded fairly passing 400M and not able to trouble leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 居後半馬群中，落後領放馬五至六個馬位。跑過四百米處時對催策反應一般。未能對領先馬匹構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W4W) Dropped out from wide draw, pushed along widest into home straight, ran on well final 200m, never nearer.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W4W) 自外檔出閘，墮後。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。最後二百米走勢良佳，以末段最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W1W3W) Slightly slow out and crowded, raced slightly behind midfield on the inside, angled out approaching 450M, 7 lengths or so back turning in, finished off very strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W1W3W) 出閘稍慢及受擠迫，居中間稍後位置，走內疊。趨近四百五十米處時向外移出。入直路時落後約七個馬位。衝刺凌厲，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Soon taken well back from the widest draw, never seen with a chance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自最外檔出閘，瞬即留居遙遙落後的位置。從未見具爭勝機會。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W2W2W5W) Settled in mid-field, switched wide for clear run 600m out, gave ground final 300m, eased once well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W2W2W5W) 居中間位置。六百米處移出外疊以望空。最後三百米墮退。遙遙落後時收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W2W2W2W) Held up after crowded leaving stalls, had to wait for run turning into home straight, tight of room 100m out, stayed on well to close on leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W2W2W2W) 出閘時受擠迫，其後留後。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。一百米處受緊迫。保持佳勢，追近領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Began only fairly, positioned 4 lengths behind the leader on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept to inside after straightening and made some progress.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，落後領放馬四個馬位，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。入直路後保持走內疊，略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Shifted out at start and bumped, raced towards rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, showed some response early in straight, made contact near 250M, weakened gradually final furlong. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 起步時向外斜跑及被碰撞，居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初對催策略有反應。接近二百五十米處時發生觸碰。最後二百米逐漸轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W3W4W) Bumped on jumping, taken back to last on settling 8Ls off the pace, plenty to make up 400M but couldn't run on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W3W4W) 躍出時發生碰撞，留居包尾位置，落後領放馬八個馬位。四百米處仍落後頗遠，但未能追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W3W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced towards rear on outer, 4 to 5 lengths back turning in, made minor progress in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W3W) 自大外檔出閘後留後，居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後四至五個馬位。直路上略為追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W6W) Away with them, raced behind midfield on the outside, improved after passing 650M, very wide turning in, kept on well early in straight, no extra final 150M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W6W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間之後位置，走外疊。跑過六百五十米處後上前。入直路時走大外疊。直路初保持佳勢。最後一百五十米再無餘力。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W1W1W1W) Shifted out and bumped at start, raced in touch with leaders, pushed along 600m out to chase leaders, ran on well but no match for winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W1W1W1W) 起步時向外斜跑，與對手互相碰撞，跟隨領先馬匹。六百米處受推策以追趕領先馬匹，走勢良佳，但不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W2W) Chased the leader, slightly weakened inside 200M, one pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 追趕領放馬。二百米處略為轉弱。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Tracked leader against rail, challenged up rail from 400m out, one paced and unable to get on terms with leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領放馬，走內欄。自四百米處起沿欄展開挑戰。末段保持同速，未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W3W) Jumped well, positioned 2 wide, 2 lengths or so back, similar position on turn, kept on evenly in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W3W) 出閘迅速，落後約兩個馬位，走第二疊。直路彎居相若位置。直路上保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W4W) Out with rest, raced 2 wide in midfield, angled out near 500M, not enough room early in straight, made good progress after passing 250M, crowded near 150M, kept on well to the line. (Finished 2nd, placed 1st.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W4W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間位置，走第二疊。接近五百米處時向外移出。直路早段空位不足。跑過二百五十米處後追前甚多。接近一百五十米處時受擠迫。保持佳勢至終點。（以第二名衝線，獲升為冠軍。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W3W) Made contact shortly after start, raced 2 wide in midfield, angled out 450M, showed limited response early in straight, kept on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W3W) 起步後不久發生觸碰，居中間位置，走第二疊。四百五十米處向外移出。直路早段對催策反應平平，保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W) Bumped shortly after start, raced at rear on the outside, 5 lengths or so back turning in, one-paced in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W) 起步後不久被碰撞，居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後約五個馬位，末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (4W3W5W5W) From wide draw restrained to race in mid-division, caught racing wide throughout, didn't pick up 400M and failed to get involved in the finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(4W3W5W5W) 自最外檔出閘，受約束，居中間位置。沿途走外疊。四百米處未能加速。末段未能參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W1W2W) Sat towards the rear 2 wide, stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W1W2W) 居後列，走第二疊。保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (3W3W3W4W) Jumped on terms and sat 3 wide with cover near the rear, made up stacks of ground to be the nearest on the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(3W3W3W4W) 與對手同步躍出，居後列，走第三疊，有遮擋。追前甚多，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W2W) Crowded shortly after start, raced at rear on the inside, 6 to 7 lengths back turning in, showed limited response in straight, kept on evenly to the line. (See Racing Incidents.)
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W2W) 起步後不久受擠迫，居後列，走內疊。入直路時落後六至七個馬位。直路上對催策反應平平，保持穩勢至終點。（見競賽事件報告。）
（氣管有血。）
